body:

JB Pritzker here.
Let me cut to the chase: **New Hampshire’s Senate race could decide whether Democrats take back the majority — _and Republicans know it._**
Donald Trump and the MAGA GOP see this seat as one of their best shots to expand their power.
They’ve already got a Republican governor in New Hampshire, and they’re betting they can flip the Senate seat next. If they win here, our chances of taking back the Senate drop to zero.
We can’t let that happen.
Chris Pappas is a proven fighter for working families — taking on Big Pharma, defending reproductive freedom, and making sure our government actually works for the people it serves.
I’ve seen what happens when leaders like Chris have the platform and the power to make change — and _I want him in the Senate._
I know Chris can win, but there’s no way around it: **This isn’t a safe blue seat, folks.**
The GOP is ready to flood New Hampshire with attack ads and dark money. The only way to beat them is with early, grassroots support. That’s where you come in:

More from Politico:
“ The moves reflect Trump’s intent to undermine programs benefiting Americans in blue-leaning states, while leaders from both parties work to negotiate a government funding agreement. Trump has suggested the shutdown could offer a pretense to cut programs he doesn’t like. "
The reasons to dump the Electoral College continue to grow. Any amount helps -- pitch in with $5, $15, or more to support efforts for a popular vote presidential election >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=102225_3&amount=15]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Politico: Trump targets states that voted for Harris in shutdown fight [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=102225_3&amount=25]
There's never been a clearer reason to get rid of the Electoral College, friend. We're watching in real time as those in control of the federal government are using it to exact revenge on states that didn't go their way in the last election. Straight from Politico:
“ The White House is targeting Democratic states with its first wave of cuts to federal projects following the government shutdown, impacting billions of dollars in funding for energy and infrastructure ”. Russ Vought, author of Project 2025 and director of the Office of Management and Budget, has gone after billions in federal spending in so-called "blue states" but not publicly announced cuts that affected any state that backed Trump in 2024.
“ We can get rid of a lot of things that we didn’t want, and they’d be Democrat things ,” Trump told reporters ahead of the shutdown. He's not even trying to hide his intent to punish the states that didn't come in for him in the Electoral College.
The Electoral College gives the vote suppressors another tool to target those who disagree with them and harm voters. We have to remove this danger once and for all -- chip in $5, $10, $15 or whatever you can to help us move towards a popular vote system >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=102225_3&amount=15]

We don’t necessarily have to wait for Congress to act, either. Movements like the one in favor of the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) -- an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia -- could end the Electoral College without a constitutional amendment.
16 states plus DC have already joined the NPVIC, accounting for 206 electoral votes and 76% of the states needed to essentially make the popular vote the law of the land. Maine is also moving a bill through their state legislature to join.
Whether it's the NPVIC or something else, it's clear that the Electoral College needs to go.
Help us end the Electoral College forever with $15 or more today! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=102225_3&amount=15]

subject: Federal Shutdown Aid ⛑️
body:
| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3b85da197a15/federal-shutdown-aid?e=8249791cac)
---
| | | | [|
---](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=1b0e4480e2&e=8249791cac)
| | Hi everyone. I know I normally do not send out more than one newsletter a month, but this one felt very important to get out. This newsletter will be all about the Federal Government shutdown and include a variety of resources to help Coloradans navigate its impacts. While no one knows how much longer this shutdown will last, we do know that it is negatively impacting Americans everywhere, especially hard-working Coloradans. To support those impacted, my office has compiled resources for SNAP, WIC, Healthcare, Social Security & Veterans, National Parks, Air Travel, Mail, Weather, and Federal Resources & Contacts.
If you need any additional help, resources, or have further questions, please do not hesitate to email me at [_brianna.titone.house@coleg.gov_](mailto:brianna.titone.house@coleg.gov?subject=&body=) __ and I will get back to you as soon as possible. I also have an upcoming town hall and constituent events, if you would like to talk in person.
---
| |
# [**SNAP & Food Resources**]()
---
| | The Colorado Department of Human resources announced today that,
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | _“Because of the federal government shutdown, the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) has not released the funds that states use to pay SNAP (food assistance) benefits. This means Colorado is unable to issue the approximately $120 million of November SNAP benefits to clients until the federal government restores funding”_([click here to view the statement](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=26c375b38d&e=8249791cac)).
---
| |
Currently, more than 334,000 Colorado households (representing about 615,000 individuals) rely on SNAP benefits to help put food on the table. Of those impacted, roughly half are children, 10% are seniors, and 15% are individuals living with disabilities.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |
“ _Our State is looking at all options for helping feed families in need and is currently having conversations about the negative impacts this will create and how to support people should the federal government not reopen. It’s time for Republicans to do the right thing and lower health care costs, reopen the federal government, and help provide food security to hardworking Coloradans, children, and people across the country_ ,” said Colorado Governor Jared Polis.
---
| |
If individuals or families in Colorado are in need of food assistance during the government shutdown, they are encouraged to contact community organizations or food banks in their area.
To find these resources in your area, please contact:
* **Colorado 211** : Dial 2-1-1 or (866)760-5489 or visit [www.211colorado.org](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=8153aa94ae&e=8249791cac)
* **Feeding Colorado Resources** at [www.feedingcolorado.org/find-food](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=0889bd79ef&e=8249791cac) or email [info@feedingcolorado.org](mailto:info@feedingcolorado.org?subject=&body=)
* **Colorado’s SNAP** website for up-to-date information [https://cdhs.colorado.gov/snap](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=852c9081c9&e=8249791cac)

---
| |
**Food Resources in Golden and Arvada:** Please visit each website for specific information regarding their proof of address requirements and for their location. Phone numbers are provided for further assistance.
**Golden**
* [**Calvary Church Golden**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=f983e9bc1d&e=8249791cac) has a “Calvary Food Shelf” that offers shelf-stable food and a variety of fresh foods, including eggs, meat, dairy, and produce.
* Open Monday-Thursday from 10 am-3 pm, and can be visited once per week. Call (303)-279-2188 for more information
* [**Golden Pantry & Thrift**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=43fcf09f25&e=8249791cac) offers a food pantry that provides essential supplies and nutritious food to those experiencing food insecurity in Golden.
* Open Tuesday-Friday from 10 am-3:30 pm. Call (303)-279-5674 for more information
* [**BGoldN**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=b72692905e&e=8249791cac) has a fresh food pantry that offers eggs, poultry, meat, dairy, fruits, and vegetables. It also offers home delivery if you are unable to get to the pantry due to a lack of transportation or mobility issues. You can fill out an application for a home delivery [here](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=982a411708&e=8249791cac).
* Open Tuesdays from 12:00 pm-4:00 pm, Wednesdays 11:00 am-3:00 pm, Thursdays 9:00 am-1:00 pm & 4:00-7:00 pm, and Fridays 11:00 am-4:00 pm. Call (720)-687-2041 for more information

**Arvada**
* [**Community Table**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=a6d84a7873&e=8249791cac) has a food pantry that offers a variety of different fresh and shelf-stable foods as well as personal care products, pet food, and more. They also offer a variety of other resources, including a mobile pantry, home delivery, weekend food for schoolchildren, emergency food bags for individuals experiencing homelessness, everyday eats for individuals aged 60+, and more. For a full list of their services and how to access them, you can [visit their website](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=0f5b3a90ca&e=8249791cac).
* Open Tuesday-Friday from 12 pm-4 pm. Call (303)-424-6685 for more information
* [**Ralston Creek Church**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=d7c83df561&e=8249791cac) offers a food pantry that is open to all with no restrictions or ID requirements.
* Open on Tuesdays and Saturdays from 9:30 am-10:30 am. Call (303)-421-1373 for more information
* [**New Apostolic Church**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=942405f8f5&e=8249791cac) also offers a food pantry that is open to all with no restrictions or ID requirements.
* Open on Wednesday from 9 am-11 am. Call (720)-504-4622 for more information
* [**The Action Center**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=91eacba7c4&e=8249791cac) offers free food and clothing with no ID requirements, but they do require appointments. They do same-day appointments through a lottery system. If you can’t get an appointment and need food now, they do offer prepared food bags. They also offer benefit assistance and family services.
* Call (303)-237-7704 for more information

**Other resources**
* [**Hunger Free Colorado**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=26571cf1af&e=8249791cac) offers a food resource hotline that is bilingual.
* [**Food Bank of the Rockies**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=744019f50b&e=8249791cac) has a food pantry locator on its website.
* [**Jefferson County Food Assistance**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=f5be173f12&e=8249791cac) provides information about SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) for eligible individuals and families.
* [**Denver Metro Emergency Food Network**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=e0bf5e8980&e=8249791cac) delivers prepared meals to homebound families and elderly individuals in need during emergencies.
* **Community Gardens** : For information on community gardens in Arvada and Golden, visit [**FindHelp.org**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=abea223945&e=8249791cac)

---
| |
# [WIC (Women, Infants, & Children)]()
---
| | The [Colorado legislature approved funds](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=4a3230641d&e=8249791cac) so the state will continue to fund WIC benefits during October. Local clinics will continue to stay open, and Coloradans can continue using their benefits like usual. For more information on WIC and the shutdown, you can visit their [website](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=583b277a74&e=8249791cac).
---
| |
# [Health First Colorado & CHP+]()
---
| | The government shutdown will have no impact on Colorado’s Medicaid program, Health First Colorado, and Child Health Plan Plus. Recipients will continue being able to get the care they need. For more information on the government shutdown, you can visit the [Health First Colorado website](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=7f2b9b7c0e&e=8249791cac).
---
| |
# [Social Security, Medicare, & Veteran’s Benefits]()
---
| | [Social Security, Medicare, and veterans' benefits](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=2d3e66196b&e=8249791cac) will still be distributed as scheduled, and recipients should receive their payments on time. However, some local offices may experience reduced staffing, which could lead to slower processing times or delays for nonessential services such as new applications or benefit inquiries.
---
| |
# [Colorado’s National Parks]()
---
| | During the government shutdown, [Colorado’s national parks](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=0adfad87a1&e=8249791cac) have remained open, but with significantly reduced services and staffing.
* Great Sand Dunes National Park, visitor centers, and fee stations are closed, and rangers are limited
* Mesa Verde National Park has shut down access to its cliff dwellings, museum, and guided tours
* Rocky Mountain National Park continues to allow visitors, but has scaled back operations
* Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park remains open, but with minimal services due to staff shortages and wildfire recovery

The state of Colorado is exploring short-term options to keep national parks open and protected, but ongoing budget constraints make it uncertain how much state funding can be used to support the parks. While temporary measures may help maintain limited operations, they are not a sustainable long-term solution, and the government shutdown is expected to significantly affect both Colorado’s national parks and the state’s recreation revenue.
---
| |
# [Air Travel]()
---
| | Most [TSA employees and air traffic controllers](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=63175baa59&e=8249791cac) are considered "essential workers”, meaning that they have to continue working during the shutdown but will not receive their pay until the shutdown ends. This means that if the shutdown goes on too long, workers might stop showing up to work, and travelers will see delays at the airport. If you are traveling internationally, getting a passport renewed might take longer, as some employees are furloughed.
---
| |
# [Mail & Postal Services]()
---
| | The [United States Postal Service (USPS)](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=c8be0ae0f8&e=8249791cac) is primarily self funded and will continue their services as usual during the government shutdown.
---
| |
# [Weather]()
---
| | The [National Weather Service](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=f40df23e91&e=8249791cac) will continue to provide routine weather forecasts and extreme weather watches and warnings. While day-to-day operations on critical services will not see interruptions, some long-term projects and maintenance upgrades might see delays.
---
| |
# [Federal Resources & Contacts]()
---
| |
Furloughed federal employees impacted by the shutdown are able to apply for [unemployment benefits through the State of Colorado](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=ed0344b5d0&e=8249791cac). However, once the employee receives their back pay from their federal government, they must repay the benefits they received from Colorado. Federal employees can apply for these benefits [here](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=5bdd86d0c9&e=8249791cac) and can find additional resources [here](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=03fb8492f7&e=8249791cac).
**Financial**
* **USAA** [Shutdown Help for Members](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=a9d78a02a2&e=8249791cac)
* **PenFed Credit Union** [Member Programs](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=ab2c6fd6fd&e=8249791cac)
* **Navy Federal Credit Union**[Shutdown Loans for Members ](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=3bd7045079&e=8249791cac)
* **FedChoice Federal Credit Union**[FedAssist Furlough Loans ](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=b206e7d625&e=8249791cac)
* **Maryland/DC Credit Union Assistance Program:** members are eligible for financial relief programs due to the [federal government shutdown](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=b599115322&e=8249791cac)
* **Cabrillo Credit Union (California)** members impacted by the shutdown (including federal employees, contractors, or others) are eligible for [loan/financial assistance](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=7534d0f60a&e=8249791cac)
* **Pennsylvania federal employees** who are laid off because of the shutdown may file [applications for UC benefits](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=56a0f8d81a&e=8249791cac)
* There are **financial resources for troops** experiencing financial distress [due to the shutdown](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=5dd4b3604a&e=8249791cac)

**Wellness**
* [**Wellfed**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=677c8453d7&e=8249791cac) offers three recurring weekly virtual programs designed to provide structure, support and momentum for professionals navigating career transitions
* **Technologists for the Public Good** has partnered with Empower Work to provide [free, confidential counseling](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=26cc164c4f&e=8249791cac)
* **Justice Connection** developed a list of [mental health support resources for federal employees](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=ccd1a365f9&e=8249791cac)
* The **U.S. Department of Health and Human Services** provides an anonymous [resource for people seeking mental health and substance use treatment](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=6dc6df4fda&e=8249791cac)
* **The Federal Employee Education & Assistance Fund** has both an [Emergency Hardship Loan program and Shutdown Grants](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=722c60ee2f&e=8249791cac) available for qualifying full-time federal civilian employees

**Food & Necessities **
* **Feeding America** [Find Your Local Food Bank ](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=844d70a36b&e=8249791cac)
* **National Diaper Bank Network** [Member Organization Locations](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=ecd419b9b7&e=8249791cac)
* **WSSC Water** will temporarily suspend water service turnoffs and waive late fees [for federal employees impacted by government shutdown](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=54981dea0e&e=8249791cac)
* **Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE)** provides expanded bill payment assistance options for federal workers affected by the shutdown to help manage energy bills and [prevent service interruptions](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=b495d3be34&e=8249791cac)
* **Pepco** provides expanded customer support measures amid shutdown to help [with bills and maintain service continuity](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=7eb681a937&e=8249791cac)
* **Southern Maryland Electric Cooperative (SMECO)** is offering extended payment arrangements, waiving otherwise applicable late payment fees and suspending disconnections for residential members[ who may be experiencing hardship due to the shutdown](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=ee3ca68524&e=8249791cac)
* **Maryland government** has implemented housing protections for involuntarily furloughed federal government [employees at risk of eviction ](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=69192e772c&e=8249791cac)
* **The Maryland Crisis Assistance Program** provides [housing stabilization assistance to help residents avoid evictions, foreclosures, and housing-related crises](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=65b8928708&e=8249791cac)
* **In Virginia,** federal employees and contractors can’t be evicted or foreclosed on [during a federal government shutdown](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=94bc5feda4&e=8249791cac)
* **The New York Common Pantry** has groceries and hot meals for furloughed federal employees [during the shutdown](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=c8d9be4760&e=8249791cac)
* **The Capital Area Foodbank** located in the DMV region helps find access to [food resources](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=6a56146a9d&e=8249791cac)
* **St. Stephen Baptist Church in Maryland** has weekly food distribution on [Tuesdays from 11-3 pm](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=f6e92a828f&e=8249791cac)

**Other**
* **Partnership for Public Service** [FedSupport Hub](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=22ae6b3f3a&e=8249791cac)
* **BeneFeds** provides information for employees leaving the federal workforce on [managing benefits as they transition from federal service](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=8e692ef555&e=8249791cac)
* **WTOP** published a list of help and [assistance programs for furloughed federal workers in the D.C., region](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=1c31b734e8&e=8249791cac)

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi everyone. I know I normally do not send out more than one newsletter a month, but this one felt very important to get out. This newsletter will be all about the Federal Government shutdown and include a variety of resources to help Coloradans navigate its impacts. While no one knows how much longer this shutdown will last, we do know that it is negatively impacting Americans everywhere, especially hard-working Coloradans. To support those impacted, my office has compiled resources for SNAP, WIC, Healthcare, Social Security & Veterans, National Parks, Air Travel, Mail, Weather, and Federal Resources & Contacts. If you need any additional help, resources, or have further questions, please do not hesitate to email me at mailto:brianna.titone.house@coleg.gov?subject=&body= and I will get back to you as soon as possible. I also have an upcoming town hall and constituent events, if you would like to talk in person. | | [SNAP & Food Resources]() | | The Colorado Department of Human resources announced today that, | | | | | | | | | | | | | | “Because of the federal government shutdown, the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) has not released the funds that states use to pay SNAP (food assistance) benefits. This means Colorado is unable to issue the approximately $120 million of November SNAP benefits to clients until the federal government restores funding”(). | | Currently, more than 334,000 Colorado households (representing about 615,000 individuals) rely on SNAP benefits to help put food on the table. Of those impacted, roughly half are children, 10% are seniors, and 15% are individuals living with disabilities. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | “ Our State is looking at all options for helping feed families in need and is currently having conversations about the negative impacts this will create and how to support people should the federal government not reopen. It’s time for Republicans to do the right thing and lower health care costs, reopen the federal government, and help provide food security to hardworking Coloradans, children, and people across the country ,” said Colorado Governor Jared Polis. | | If individuals or families in Colorado are in need of food assistance during the government shutdown, they are encouraged to contact community organizations or food banks in their area. To find these resources in your area, please contact: Colorado 211 : Dial 2-1-1 or (866)760-5489 or visit Feeding Colorado Resources at or email mailto:info@feedingcolorado.org?subject=&body= Colorado’s SNAP website for up-to-date information | | Food Resources in Golden and Arvada: Please visit each website for specific information regarding their proof of address requirements and for their location. Phone numbers are provided for further assistance. Golden has a “Calvary Food Shelf” that offers shelf-stable food and a variety of fresh foods, including eggs, meat, dairy, and produce. Open Monday-Thursday from 10 am-3 pm, and can be visited once per week. Call (303)-279-2188 for more information offers a food pantry that provides essential supplies and nutritious food to those experiencing food insecurity in Golden. It also offers home delivery if you are unable to get to the pantry due to a lack of transportation or mobility issues. You can fill out an application for a home delivery . Open Tuesdays from 12:00 pm-4:00 pm, Wednesdays 11:00 am-3:00 pm, Thursdays 9:00 am-1:00 pm & 4:00-7:00 pm, and Fridays 11:00 am-4:00 pm. Call (720)-687-2041 for more information Arvada has a food pantry that offers a variety of different fresh and shelf-stable foods as well as personal care products, pet food, and more. For a full list of their services and how to access them, you can . Open Tuesday-Friday from 12 pm-4 pm. Call (303)-424-6685 for more information offers a food pantry that is open to all with no restrictions or ID requirements. Open on Tuesdays and Saturdays from 9:30 am-10:30 am. Call (303)-421-1373 for more information also offers a food pantry that is open to all with no restrictions or ID requirements. Open on Wednesday from 9 am-11 am. Call (720)-504-4622 for more information offers free food and clothing with no ID requirements, but they do require appointments. They do same-day appointments through a lottery system. If you can’t get an appointment and need food now, they do offer prepared food bags. They also offer benefit assistance and family services. Call (303)-237-7704 for more information Other resources offers a food resource hotline that is bilingual. has a food pantry locator on its website. provides information about SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) for eligible individuals and families. delivers prepared meals to homebound families and elderly individuals in need during emergencies. Community Gardens : For information on community gardens in Arvada and Golden, visit | | [WIC (Women, Infants, & Children)]() | | The so the state will continue to fund WIC benefits during October. Local clinics will continue to stay open, and Coloradans can continue using their benefits like usual. For more information on WIC and the shutdown, you can visit their . | | [Health First Colorado & CHP+]() | | The government shutdown will have no impact on Colorado’s Medicaid program, Health First Colorado, and Child Health Plan Plus. Recipients will continue being able to get the care they need. For more information on the government shutdown, you can visit the . | | [Social Security, Medicare, & Veteran’s Benefits]() | | will still be distributed as scheduled, and recipients should receive their payments on time. However, some local offices may experience reduced staffing, which could lead to slower processing times or delays for nonessential services such as new applications or benefit inquiries. | | [Colorado’s National Parks]() | | During the government shutdown, have remained open, but with significantly reduced services and staffing. Great Sand Dunes National Park, visitor centers, and fee stations are closed, and rangers are limited Mesa Verde National Park has shut down access to its cliff dwellings, museum, and guided tours Rocky Mountain National Park continues to allow visitors, but has scaled back operations Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park remains open, but with minimal services due to staff shortages and wildfire recovery The state of Colorado is exploring short-term options to keep national parks open and protected, but ongoing budget constraints make it uncertain how much state funding can be used to support the parks. While temporary measures may help maintain limited operations, they are not a sustainable long-term solution, and the government shutdown is expected to significantly affect both Colorado’s national parks and the state’s recreation revenue. | | [Air Travel]() | | Most are considered "essential workers”, meaning that they have to continue working during the shutdown but will not receive their pay until the shutdown ends. ## **Frozen Odds Movie Update:**
**I am so thankful to all the people who bought tickets to “Frozen Odds” I was able to put together an amazing setup for equipment and little did I know that AFPI, America First Policy Institute would be so interested in working directly with me to help make content, do presentations, and show my movie all over the country. I have been working with them for a couple months now planning our strategy in Michigan, which is facing a ballot measure to get RCV in Michigan in 2026. The movie will be 45 minutes, the first trailer will come out in October and the movie release will be December or January for Alaska.****I am working directly with AFPI executive team and we plan to bring big name people to various events to get large crowds, their goal is 400-500+ per event and plan to do events across Michigan, having my movie as the main showcase with a panel doing Q &A at the end.****I am not charging AFPI for the movie, videos, or content I have created for them. I believe they will pay for the events, marketing, and flying me to Michigan for the various events. I had no idea that my work would make such a difference and I am very proud and thankful to all the people that have supported all of my efforts.****Seeing Charlie Kirk die reminds me that the work doesn’t stop, it never will and we have to carry on doing what he started.****Our work doesn’t stop in Michigan, I am also working with AFPI in Georgia and Minnesota next.**

name: hear.com
subject: Hearing aids just got their biggest upgrade
body:
Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zgn1vjtbvfl9uma2rd8vhfq02glkpre1ipkgmtg8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs)
---
| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z22gaug0d6tc78lekip5tfsjfe0ha9f1551hcp90_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z7d6ncfscv1fmdkmutsv89c9vniqj4g8fhftufgg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zq392mq9ekrta662ts529ktkt4pqdt7amqo8cuho_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z5hmhp13lgg05cgdu5b1qrr54smh56rf1q7h2nsg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs)
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zoenkfn2e3suhhfbi9sglncff30u7o5p4um1b5o8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs)
What makes [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zmdhoe5anprr06c0nrvg1l33051m2sairqobrg68_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zqvbaju9rp7q3kl5drrhc2lf3p4gvilb16g806kg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zjeer45cv9cboqd6gej2ad5ahcs65jgp8k2nmv40_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

Limited no-risk trials now available

Click below to check if you qualify for a 45-day no-risk trial. As the Germans always say: "there's never been a better time." So do yourself a favor and don’t wait. **Get started today.**
[Check if you qualify](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zt3p4k0dahkahu90d5nlrlrmt856rpubrqm3cab0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c9i6cor6cth2bs)

name: INGOP
subject: ICYMI: Governor Mike Braun Rallies Students At Packed Turning Point USA Event At Indiana University
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE
body:
Indiana Gov. Mike Braun provided the warmup for the Turning Point USA event Tuesday evening at the Indiana University auditorium. No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-e-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-p/) **IN CASE YOU MISSED IT** [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-r/) **Governor Mike Braun Rallies Students At Packed Turning Point USA Event At Indiana University** Madelyn HanesOctober 21, 2025
[https://indianacapitalchronicle.com/2025/10/21/braun-rallies-students-at-packed-turning-point-usa-event-at-indiana-university/](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-y/)Indiana Gov. Mike Braun provided the warmup for the Turning Point USA event Tuesday evening at the Indiana University auditorium.The sold-out event, part of the group's "American Comeback Tour," drew thousands to hear Braun and former Fox News host Tucker Carlson, who headlined following founder Charlie Kirk's assassination last month."What Charlie represented was not being embarrassed about what I ran on and what got me into the game in the first place, faith, family and community," he said. "You throw a little freedom and opportunity on top of that, we never should shy away from shouting it into the rafters."The Bloomington stop came weeks after Kirk was killed Sept. 10 during the tour's kickoff at Utah Valley University. Police arrested 22-year-old Tyler Robison, who remains held without bail at the Utah County Jail.The event drew more than 3,000 people with a long standby line outside.Governor remarksBraun, a former U.S. senator who left Washington to lead Indiana, framed the moment as traditional values vs. prioritizing government over individual liberty."We're in a classic battle between those values and folks that believe government is the most important thing in your life. Don't ever go there. Always resist it. Be loud about it. Can I count on you for that?" he asked.Braun drew hearty applause from the audience, many of whom wore red and white Turning Point USA hats or waved small American flags. He credited Kirk for encouraging open debate and for drawing young conservatives into civics."Charlie invited that. That was unusual. Most people didn't want to go into the lion's den. They wanted to be safe," he said.For much of his address, Braun mixed personal stories with political reflection. He spoke about risks he took in his career, his experience running a family business and his decision to leave Washington to serve as governor."You won't go anywhere in life without sticking your neck out," he said. "Take risks on the things you believe in, and then work your butts off to do it."Braun warned that conservatives have been "flat-footed" while opponents dominate the media and campuses. He praised TPUSA's growth to thousands of chapters, urging the audience to be "foot soldiers."He closed his remarks with a story about President Donald Trump and longtime Indiana basketball coach Bobby Knight, recalling a 2016 campaign stop when Knight told him, "All you've got to do is listen to the Donald, and you'll be okay."Following Braun's remarks, Carlson took the stage with his two dogs and answered questions from the audience after only a short intro.### [Click Here to Read the Full Story](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-j/) [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-t/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-i/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-d/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-h/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-k/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qkrtlyd-hhlljjcji-u/) ** PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE. ****NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. ****WWW.INDIANA.GOP.** | Indiana Republican State Committee 101 W. ## US Hits Russia with New Sanctions
The U.S. Treasury announced [sweeping new sanctions](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uwzAMxfHTyFsMivLnoKGLt3TtaLARHbOQrUBUEvj2hXuFrm_4Ae__dZ2vJFH2-ydt7MuS5p3fGrkUznN-qgrtSvutSNp1kyiF8pFnBGwvFi7o5kASj7mpgl-YkV3F3vadRdtAM1arb9vOkYVAo4M-LNQCt-1ItFA3sutcJf7ULKCzAD0OtbVusI4cDcMYIFjTAAcpKdc_Sfay8hKP9OJc39JWRb-W8lDjPgxOBqc1bVyXzKTPfNT39DI4nZcMTo_MqpfMkUn5HPQbcIQq-_B4S4yiXW8auG8k8c8u_wry8vgbAAD__1CTdKs) Wednesday against Russia’s two largest oil companies, Rosneft and Lukoil, targeting dozens of subsidiaries in a bid to choke off funding for the Kremlin’s war in Ukraine. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the action comes amid President Putin’s refusal to negotiate a ceasefire, adding that further steps may follow if [Moscow remains defiant](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ8GOpA9xsEpXNyGLrfdEk3wEGbjn8h2gnj7FfsK2x3pSOfo-75u8w3Zc3z8x0C2rmmOtBdPtVKe87sUxlgwLpVTLIE9V8xHnkGA7qToQM0O2R_z0Dq7EgGplqwcLxLkIIZru1m66xXVMBpwo0a9GqI7aDRmQAAD0LI916QAJYUYwfRSKiMVKjTm6oSTzSDIcU25_04c60arP9KHcr-k0Hq71foqjfrXwNTAtO97f-CW0tk2MJ04DUyYKy-ezhiwFP5Q53KK1AUuhT11WCsuz-79zMiROqGllFqbsd9q8G227rWz91wuYzOIR0D2v_f1T84-Fn4CAAD__y6_gRA). Peace efforts led by President Trump have stalled, with a planned summit with Putin now scrapped. Trump has backed a ceasefire along current front lines, which Ukrainian President Zelensky called a “good compromise,” but the Kremlin has shown little urgency to negotiate. President Trump, meanwhile, [ruled out sending Tomahawk](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ_GdD7ZazigcJGG7tKmRAs2x-aMjezlEG8fkVf4u5FG82lm_rzGF1Kg-P6Nm7e8pDH6swTP7POYj1IIY8E4M6VYNgrEmK88goJGaiXBjA4pXGNdObt4D95U3ur2qUHXqu6r1Ro9YdMrPTVT3zcLgJkngzgvbd-ZrtMV2ZumFRitVAvdQ2vTaYMGu653ymlRK--IU378TRR59Uu40tfnx5y2KtiVeS_C_BIwCBjitafCtyVguMECBq1uDQKGo8h7n4CB87HtsqwpcZEunVEWHx3Ftzw-GSl6yWnDFc-P3KgUCv5OVdm6_aQQqDxbUav3hhT-9-Afnfe18C8AAP__kn-DLw) cruise missiles to Ukraine, citing their complexity and a “tremendous learning curve” that would require lengthy U.S. training. Speaking during a White House meeting with NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte, Trump said the U.S. won’t fire the weapons on Ukraine’s behalf or train foreign militaries to use them.
## Earth Has a Temporary Second 'Moon'
NASA has officially confirmed the presence of a second, albeit temporary, [celestial companion to Earth](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAQhJ8GOpB_8AGFizR0lzYl2rOXYyNjn-zNWbx9RF4h3Ugjzej7vu7rHShQfH7CgZa3tEasJSAz5jX_lEIQC0THlGI5KBBDPvOqhDKdFJ3SqwcK5zq03m6ICnWLVo43qeQghrndLZjRoBkfanAPfGiH3rnJeW_mWRtndEv2WpNCaSnEqKZeSj1JDRqmafbCy2YQ6IlT7r8TRd5xC2d6Y-5dOtpgd-ZXafRHo5ZGLbXW_oQ9patt1HLhNGqBzOQCXjFCgc6luFE-SoeQee9iqh3X1CmpZ3PTZux3PkKbrX9VCoHKbWwG8TyAwt8r_0vV26rfAAAA__87BX4y): an asteroid named 2025 PN7. Known as a quasi-moon, the 19-meter-wide rock has been traveling alongside our planet since the 1960s, following a similar orbit around the Sun. Discovered this year by astronomers at the Pan-STARRS observatory in Hawaii, 2025 PN7 is [not gravitationally bound to Earth](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb1jwsBMyMGSotyRDh44WhUf8WgwRkFj5-ypV_6D71T1H5-M0nyxFStezXdG0kOeEW43YGpa53Gslm6pNrlFOdaVIzZZnmUHAyKXgoGZvKT7nofMmIAKqDo3c7yTIQQyHbjFBBzyEMDil1WdQo5M7P2rwAUC4157M600KUFKIPeheSqWlsspqffDCSzYI9NRy6b8ypbZgiM_8wNK7vHbRLK3dKlNHBhODadu2_ldptRR7l_v7N4OpOsLksKFbGEy2NHIRuRxBjiOMDKY3W9rCK7qcPD9dLmd-Pr4fucspUFkrB6FVv7Q1dsX420YxUt3t2SCuf5y1a__K9zDwEwAA__89roN7), unlike our natural Moon. It will fly off on its own in 2083, 58 years from now.
## Military Robot Breaks Industry Taboo
Foundation, a San Francisco startup, has openly defied Silicon Valley’s ethical norms by developing the first humanoid robot [explicitly designed for warfare](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ8Gd1iwOLEpKK5xl2uvtIhZ4j1hiGATy2__K3mFvxtppBl937_bcvOUKD_--h0dx7JkPFpCZqxLfbVGPjefV6aS206J2NezLqDgIrWSYJbgKZ3L0AUXEQFNh06PVw16UIPtNqdxgHGd4B7CCtGqEH1cJ4U6Bm2NvXfkPmtagdFKjTD1WptJG2_8NNmgghaDwkBcav-_UOYNYzrLG2u_lr1LbmN-NmH-CJgFzMdx9KffSvm0AuYPjoDZV6Y14TeSfJYDKwbZSgqEtcnttftcKMha7oWbBKMALtZe-4331FUXngelRO06ikE9dk_p-86_UvZ28BMAAP__Z56BdQ). The 5-foot-9, 175-pound robot, called the Phantom MK-1, can carry up to 44 pounds and is expected to be weaponized for battlefield deployment. Co-founder Mike LeBlanc, a former Marine, described the robots as “bullet sponges instead of soldiers,” positioning them as [autonomous ground drones](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO4zAMQE9jdzL0c2IXKrZxl223NGiJjrmQpUBiYuT2g2SQucCUDyDIx_fvMl-AIqXrX9jR8ZrnhEeNyIxlLvdaCVKF5JlyqjtFYijPMmupe6Gk0GYOQPE52za4FVGjadGp80lpZaUd280Z1etxGfsQzAkHj6ZfvDVqMdJa62Fsyb22KamNkvKsh04pMygDBoZhDDKoxkoMxLl0_zMl3nCNz_zA0vm8t9FtzLfamD-Nnho9HcfRbfcdUqZQ326vsUZPK2Jo9BRyYlExBQFih0IJP1Tyklms-Z4CvN4VPn8TFhGQgWIVnwLiRuw3seYifo61xYXbQTFSPZ0bK687UHw78q_CPpz-CgAA___RdJDI) capable of handling high-risk missions. _“The future of warfare is real-life video games,”_ CEO Sankaet Pathak said. _“Air, land, sea—all of them will be autonomous.”_ Foundation has already moved beyond prototypes, securing $10 million in defense contracts with the U.S. Navy, Air Force, and Army for logistics, planning, and aircraft sustainment. The company plans to produce 10,000 units by next year. [Watch a report here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFOwzAQxvGncbZG9tlpnMEDAmUrEiyM0bW-pIccu9imUXl6FF6B8ZM-_Yb_x2k6IQeOyyuu5OqcpkhbCVQr5Sl_l8IYC8ZL5RTLyoEr5keeQEJ3UPIAevLI4TGZxruZCEg35FR_VKCMNENzdWDP3TBbTfJoLlZ3nRxo6KwnGtTZYN-w2zUlQSspe7CtUtoqjRqtHbz0ShhJnmvK7WfiWK80h0e6U24vaW2Cu9Z6K0I_CRgFjNu2tRxLxSXjuj8EjJkoCBhf3kZIX-_Py8--muz8beMQuBx7YeSyIoc_sv6rw93BbwAAAP__2HVwyw).

## Texas Lawmaker Nominated for Trump Admin Role
State Sen. Brian Birdwell (R-Granbury) has been nominated by President Trump to be an [assistant secretary of defense](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd0QwJrZcUKShWOntlittY03COEbCYDGT-OXvV8kvvPpK995z_n7NX5hyKvffuJGX76XOhQ7OJEJt3vDJvD8aHyjUWrqvwpEw4wwGztoaDf0cMeXX7LroryZOtiNvx8GCHWFw3eoXMCNMo4lL7G80xOncR7he--nsbpOxtkv-XWYN9NYaa8zJTYOjoUdH4wBXQOUMxSS1nWQloW_kJb_qk9rpVrcu-1VkZ9VfFAQF4TiO08blnSkIVPSDFYQ3lIJQZaWmIOyNOEUqoqU9tl2XuqWCQqxLbbLqz4pmKii1aWSNzIkFi2imWyPB9tJ10ZEWKkwKAjZ9udg__-Kv0DUf9yPlnHgYlTP3DVP-fJWfGX56-B8AAP__8r-TIw), according to a list of nominations sent to the U.S. Senate on Tuesday. A U.S. Army veteran who was deployed to the Middle East during the Gulf War, Birdwell has served in the Texas Senate since 2010 and announced he would not seek reelection earlier this year. Birdwell underwent 39 surgeries after being [severely injured](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOqzAQgOHTmC7IMxj7Ubh40oou226JxvEELJmA7FlIbr_aXGH7X1_xf12nK6WcHvMnrezled-mB581swiXaaWj1v271JOES0nzIjUyZZpQY38BfcFuipTyazJN9EHHARr24CwgOLSmWTwNPZIb3M2EYPp_pr8FF-AOA2rrLAxN8r8YaOwANGjdmsEath0ZdhYDkjKaY5KttLKw8JPqPb-2g0t729Ym-0Vkr6r7r3BUOFZ-kHD77tp5OxSOK6-BS7svu-rGqLoPxKb4uJ8p51StU0bPK6X89uRvFw6PPwEAAP__L_dwIA) during the 9/11 attack on the Pentagon while working as a staffer for the Department of the Army. Following the announcement, Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick [called Birdwell](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO6jAQgOHTOB3IMzaOXbh40lM6VtttGU3wQKx1CLIHCLdfsVfY9i--4v86jkfKJV8vH7RwlO28jld-tsIiXMeFHq3d7rU9SbjWfJmlJaZCI2o87EDv0IyJcnmNtktx0ilAxxF6Bwg9OtvNERNyChrZ945PbnIH41wKPRn2k7XQ5fjGQKMB0KD13gZn2Rmy3DuckJTVnLKsdS8zC2_UzuW1PrjuT-vSlTiL3Joy_xQOCoftXRUO_-n6SVLz6Vvh0ITk3hQOELwO3gcIDrzxGhx0NabbM5eSm-uV1ZeFcvml5W9DHhF_AgAA__9VJHHb) "one of the greatest senators ever to serve Texas" and said he would "give his all and serve our country honorably in his next mission." Birdwell would [replace](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGP4yAQBeBfgzssGBOcFBRp3OWuuOK0lTUO45gVBgsmcfLvV8lf2PpJn957_y_jBUMM6fYHV3L8nPOYaK-RmKmMKz5q3e6l7shUSrgtXD1hxBEUHKRWErrRY4iv0TTeTcqfdENO91aD7sGaZnF4BG1nUIDT1Gs1IR0O-ng0xqO9XrVvgntjWkGntdJKteZkDdkODfUWJkBhFPnAubS8ENMT6xxf-UGlvea1iW5h3qrozgIGAcO-7-1a0zsTMFCS9ypgeI8SMGReqAgYPoqsjEyyUpJTCZjkFIrfKUaZ8hoSMnnJWUZCT6UuYZNbroFDThJZepopVZKeNiy8UmIBAxZ5Puu_X_9e301xfttDjKHaXhh1WzHET2P-3c8PBz8BAAD__52clZI) Christopher J. Lowman, who managed logistics for the military before retiring last year as assistant secretary of defense for sustainment.
## Tarrant County Road Renamed
The Fort Worth City Council voted 9-2 on Tuesday to [rename a one-mile stretch](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOnDAQBOCnMZ2RvfjgKFykofvTpkTLeQFLBqP1Bu7ePuJeId1U34zmz8_4gzHFffmNG3l5z3nc6SqJRIjHDc9Sjr9cLhRijssqJRAmHMHAQ1ujoRkDxvQZXRX8ZEJvK_K2ay3YDlpXrd7ODYIN5jX1jxbs1PfP1_PxJAfYo-mxiv7GrIHGWmONqV3fOmobdNS1MAEqZyhEyVzLSkJvLHP65JO4fuWtSn4VOYpqfikYFAxzZrkyy8p0ZJY686JguCsUDNbc2SoYDmTRedbXGoV0IZFEG-2iOWPQcde3o7-Qlqwn0kw7bhT0RUVKDKQDx5MUDBX7cFwxpVjaTjmzbBjTd5v836Onh38BAAD__8XJi70) of White Settlement Road to Westside Drive. The change was requested by Dallas-based Larkspur Capital, the developer of a 37-acre, $1.7 billion mixed-use development called Westside Village. Paved in the 1950s, the corridor connects Fort Worth to the historic town of White Settlement in western Tarrant County. The community is named after a trading post established near several Native American villages that were [abandoned](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOtB6cfClcHENXa69Em3wElsyMbI3OLz9iXuFvxtppBl939_H_KAQw_v1hza28l3T_OZaIotwnjc6Stk_uVQSzjm8vBTHFGlGwFunoMNhdhTiOevW2Se4u2rZKjMqVAZH3XoLpHBVZtHEy3o3OICjJ4HRqG40MLTBXmMKcFAKFECv76PmcSDNZsQnUqOBXZCUe_Es_KWyxjMdnPslbW20XmQvzfC7wanBqdban-RTutoGpwunwYmyhCXyFdeUpaspi--WIGe3pM97CbGjfc_p4NIB4m0wo_7Ve9lim63ba4gxlNE0Gl4bhfj_Wn4m7LD4LwAA__84yYCE) after the 1841 Battle of Village Creek. Some local residents and businesses opposed the move, arguing that it would amount to erasing history and incur significant administrative costs. Larkspur Capital stated that it would cover the estimated $26,000 cost of [updating street signs](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu4yAQheGnwR0RDMTYhYtt3N1tt7TGMMRI2EQwN9y8_Sr7Clsf6Ujf_-dr-8KU0_X4jSct_BPLdlFvmZipbie-Wnt-19aRqdb0OLgFwowbKLhLrSSYLWDK780OYdlVmPVAi3ajBu1gtMOxxGjAzX7HKe4GXAjReUNxcuZutEM_pOVzphUYrZVW6mbn0dJo0JIbYQcUVlFIXOqND2L6wRbzu7yo3nw5h7wczM8mzC8Bq4C1937rEfEzClixcvKZBKwfl4A1F49ZwMpYK14sffm--C1gfZbKqVyyRNmPxCQbMWc66WJZCwbJRe4kK114UpCxVJa9VD4ErDA56WDWyhoryWoj7WiVnI0LMngH98mPEfdpqEt49pRzaqMTVj1OTPkfg_8v_muBvwEAAP__rEOYrA) and work with businesses affected by the change. White Settlement resident Aaron James, however, [insisted](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOnDAQRL8GOiN7cexQuEhDd2lTogUvYMlgZO_hu7-PyC-ke8VoNPP-vKYXhhjO7Tce5PizpumkWiIxU54OvEu53rlUZMo5bDsXTxhxAgk_hJIC-sljiN9Jt97N0g-qJaesUaAsGN3ubrBazqtXNJufVg49WgQ7LzPKHtDIoQ3uKVMSeqWkkrLTg9FketRkDcyAjZbkA6fc8U5MHyxr_Kabcreko41uZ75K0_9qYGxgrLV2a_ro58YTaGB8sIFxTZlFTZl3saT3uYQo8LpyuqmIJZ38UC4Bo6h7YBKFmCMddLLICb048SCx7Hhu1GbnrxpiDMXYRsvtwBD_zeH_k3g7-BsAAP__1aWKdg), "_These names are not mere labels. They are embodiments of our past. Reminders of how far we’ve come, and markers of the complex interactions of our ancestors_."
## Spurs Beat Mavs in Opener
The San Antonio Spurs [beat the Dallas Mavericks](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-O4yAQgPGnwV0sZiA2KSiuQboi116JxmGwkfAfARsnb7_KvsLWn_Qrvv93f6eU0zb_o5Vte8Xdb3zWzK1x8Ss9az2-Sj2pcSlpXloNTJk8SrxeQF5Q-UApv73ugp1kuEHHFsYBEEYcdLfYCUCHOCn5MDChidGwZKOiGSkGZtMl-8FAogKQIGWvb4PmQZHmccAJSWjJIbW99G3hxi-qMb_3J5f-sa9dtktrRxXqj0An0J3n2XM9tk8U6LaJBLrCDzoEOi_QzbTy3yDQaQlG3lBdu2LDcaacUx1GoeW8Uso_ePvdkqfF7wAAAP__U5p0DQ) 125-92 in last night's season opener thanks to a virtuoso performance by center Victor Wembanyama. Mavericks No. 1 draft pick Cooper Flagg struggled in his first NBA game, scoring just 10 points. Wembanyama dominated on both sides of the court for San Antonio. The presumptive favorite for [Defensive Player of the Year](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb8GukG2MbAUFGm2e2lTojEeYPSMQfZkvfx9tPmF119dnXP-fM1fyIHj9hsPmuS9nnOkkgOJUJoPfOV8_U25oFBKvO2SPWHA2SjTgVZg2tkjh3u2tZ-c8qOuadJDr40eTG_rfXo4Pa6tddaPS6c9rn03LEPn_MM_RtKu5ulzppVptVZaqcaOvaW-RUtDb5zByiryLGdqZCehN-Y13OeLUrOcRx2mXeTKVfurMs_KPEspjcP8TeIwhEhSzvTdRJLKPAMKZYGPYWWeibaNCQ4OgRJciTwvkqHQ4TDeeCAUDgEKR_DXeQNGDytHzjvIeUEHHOF4XZBwoTpN_vrMOfdDZdV2IIf_fPKzqq_J_AsAAP__r0GQmg) added three blocked shots to a 40-point, 15-rebound game. Spurs rookie Dylan Harper—the No. 2 pick in the draft—added 15 points in his first NBA game. The Mavericks' Anthony Davis muscled in 22 points as Dallas' most consistent scoring option, but starting point guard Kyrie Irving's absence was apparent. Irving is expected to return after Christmas as he recovers from an [ACL tear](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFurTAQRL_GdKD1YsyjcPEaups2JVrwAlYMRrYDl7-PyC-kmmY0o3M-X8OLnHf78kEbm_yew7DzlTznzHHY6Ezp-I7poswxumXNyTJ5GhCwKSWUWA-WnL8HVVgzgu1kwUa2WqJsUatiNePcNFZDZ7W2YLtJN5alphFxBq1qLpx5xiRgLSVIgEp1WrGuSXGrcUQSCti6HGKVV878pjT7O5wcqylshTdrzkcS9X-BvcB-oiodIeZU3bSG8HQE9g-UwP7rjo5LF0-3L-Xh6X4yMaWwlzT5Ev7VALJTXbXmzRfR2ONy3rukW6Fg2cj539P8N1WnwZ8AAAD__0ZifkI) he suffered last March. Following [Houston's loss](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAQQL8Gd6xgINguKNLQXdqU1ngZ2ygYLIZb3_59dPmF1E96enq_P5YPTDmV_Ree5PvXVpdCN2fqndpy4ov5-mx8Y6fW0n50joQZF1DwQ2olwSwRU34vdoh-VXHWA3k9Og16BGeHw0-zm4yeJ20mO25kn0DGzBtGiuu2IQ3Jf8u0AqO10ko97OwsOYOWRgcroLCKYuq1PfpBnb6Qt_yuL2qPZz2H7I_eLxbmp4AgINz3_SC-yjcUEMqKAgL32t4CwiIgpCggWOcmpUclIMTPhqXLKxWWTMi1yHpRSWWXuTLLVp9_qLPcMOeh-XjdKefEbhRW7Sem_C-j_9-8l4e_AQAA__--mIQR) to the Thunder on Tuesday night, the Spurs are the only team in Texas to start their season with a win. Do Everything Better”** And it’s already happening. Just look at fast food. [Miso Robotics](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O2zAMgJ_G3hJQP5HjQUOBQ7br2lGgIyYmIFmGRDt3b184LfoCXfl9IInv12f4RE68PH9iJi9fjxIWerVEIlRDxr21davthUK18nOWFgkTBg36clJw0iZE5PQdbB_9BHFUPXk1OKXVoJ3tZw84jNfBqVG56yMiGTfYESarxnG6aK179scyBdooBQrgbEdnyRm0NDg9aewsUGQp9SwzCX1he6TvslM930vuk59F1taZH52-dfrGy05NzplbqWUqwvd2eAc0t01yaGWrd-rMB2Xk1Gl3DDNF3nJnPlbkeFqxykK1zbz-5XfMK_JzeRv_oLrCycIQ_oTYFhYMxqgrXOxFAfTVx_XFKXFzQ2fheRx8Py3_l3r3-ncAAAD__yUBkso) is already delivering an AI-powered fry-cooking robot called Flippy, which can cook perfectly and never calls in sick. [https://secure.winred.com/marjorie-taylor-greene-s-people-over-politicians-c/mtg_don_wmb_er_sw-pe_rs_20251023?recurring=true&utm_term=lrm-active]

favor to discredit me and make me go away because I’m committed to
exposing what the Swamp has spent years trying to hide.

trail.

*

*
I’M CALLING OUT AIPAC FOR BUYING INFLUENCE IN CONGRESS AND TELLING
THE TRUTH ABOUT WHAT IS HAPPENING IN GAZA.

*
I’M FIGHTING TO STOP YOUR TAX DOLLARS FROM BEING WASTED ON SENSELESS

*

committed to being that voice for my voters in Georgia who want their
representatives in DC to clean up our corrupt government and fight for
policies that put America First.

Not only am I fighting smear campaigns on multiple fronts but Leftist

**Roslyn Williams** is a community leader, ministry founder, and political organizer whose life embodies transformation through faith and truth. As **Grassroots Engagement Director for Americans for Prosperity in Southeast Pennsylvania** , Roslyn works every day to help individuals rediscover the power of faith, family, and freedom to shape their communities from the ground up.
**[CLICK TO PURCHASE YOUR TICKET.](https://substack.com/redirect/aa056ecb-e9b8-4370-8663-ed393d958a48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
Her journey began in Philadelphia, where she founded and led a women's ministry for 12 years before marrying and moving to Georgia. There, she volunteered on a local campaign that ignited her passion for civic engagement. Once aligned with the Democratic Party out of habit, Roslyn experienced a personal awakening in 2020--realizing her values of faith, service, and family were more closely aligned with conservative principles. She officially switched parties in 2022 and now helps others find the courage to vote their convictions, not party labels.
At **Seed & Roots 2025**, Roslyn will share how faith and courage can restore moral clarity to our politics and purpose to our communities. Her story reminds us that change doesn't start in Washington--it starts in the human heart and in the neighborhoods we call home.
🗓 **Saturday, October 25, 2025**
📍 **Philadelphia, PA | Independence Visitor Center**
⏰ **9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Doors open at 8:30 AM)**
* * *
### ⚙️ **Why Does It Matter**
Because the health of our democracy depends on citizens who think for themselves, not on politicians who speak for them. Roslyn's message is both timeless and urgent: when ordinary people find their voice, rediscover truth, and act with conviction, extraordinary things happen.

In this episode, Matt Royer engages with Larry Wohlers and Parson Brown from New Rural Virginia to discuss the upcoming elections in Virginia, focusing on the unique challenges and perspectives of rural candidates. They explore the rural-urban divide, the importance of economic issues to voters, and the impact of national politics on local elections. The conversation highlights the significance of community engagement and the need for rural candidates to be heard in a political landscape often dominated by urban narratives.
Check out New Rural Virginia:
* [Website](https://substack.com/redirect/9ae69803-86d0-433a-b2ea-156f9fcafbca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* [The Rural Angle Substack](https://substack.com/redirect/ea3ad94c-6333-4be6-a570-0c234440570d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* [New Rural's Conversations Podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/60154a48-d9f4-4b8e-b584-c7bc0aa61150?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* [Instagram](https://substack.com/redirect/835b56ed-49b2-4902-b2c4-f0f1f66e57da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

TL;DR
* New Rural Virginia aims to connect rural communities with practical solutions.
* Rural candidates often prioritize community service over political fame.
* The rural-urban divide affects perceptions and priorities in politics.
* Economic issues, such as cost of living, are top concerns for rural voters.
* Data centers present both opportunities and challenges for rural areas.
* National politics can significantly influence local elections and candidate perceptions.
* Rural candidates face unique challenges, including lack of resources and support.
* Community engagement is crucial for rural candidates to succeed.
* Voter priorities often focus on immediate economic concerns over social issues.
* The potential for change in rural voting patterns is growing.

body:
We laugh at Boebert’s antics because she's a joke, but why she’s pushing this one is sinister...
| | | | | [](https://t7pkg9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013QcCFAZcKPiE29pTRCDWosMbL4B8X7ayKzsnb4cT-cpwyevHszrtiX7VUZ5a3SyxcqgfreaKAJvTYosNRrt8vqmnUbt3_jVQShuYas8sB2IQv1ejbzXF9V33QGhDAn2fOjd6Qr-tCS5Khl7hbdPF5QxyugwA-Mn6hWskXjLP7zD8bBeZuHKuqtjTcc6Ry_nTAXT14-ohzDmfdA6jPDyvNlsTP7olfTGy&c=5evYKd_GAuBEG5hrOWR6WjYY3XQEJaCStKeboV7SlviivF0aK1Zy7Q==&ch=COWhsyiVqxw_pIim_byoAeJZzBfOdR6pnmDi0yHjMVAtg7sLVE6GcA==)

Peter,
On Monday, Lauren Boebert began pushing a new conspiracy theory that House Speaker Hakeem Jeffries is a "reptilian."
This is related to a conspiracy pushed by Holocaust denier David Icke who postulates that most Jews, and many people in positions of power across the world, secretly belong to a race of reptilians, with a sinister plan to eradicate humanity.
It's funny to laugh at Boebert's antics because she's a joke, last week it was her push to get to the bottom of extraterrestrials now it's lizardmen. However she has a dark reason for pushing this one...
---
| [](https://t7pkg9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013QcCFAZcKPiE29pTRCDWosMbL4B8X7ayKzsnb4cT-cpwyevHszrtiX7VUZ5a3SyxcqgfreaKAJvTYosNRrt8vqmnUbt3_jVQShuYas8sB2IQv1ejbzXF9V33QGhDAn2fOjd6Qr-tCS5Khl7hbdPF5QxyugwA-Mn6hWskXjLP7zD8bBeZuHKuqtjTcc6Ry_nTAXT14-ohzDmfdA6jPDyvNmXBhoJamj5J&c=5evYKd_GAuBEG5hrOWR6WjYY3XQEJaCStKeboV7SlviivF0aK1Zy7Q==&ch=COWhsyiVqxw_pIim_byoAeJZzBfOdR6pnmDi0yHjMVAtg7sLVE6GcA==)
---
Congressman Clay Higgins is a close ally of Boebert. In 2023 when an activist asked Boebert an unfriendly question at a presser with Higgins, he went on the attack manhandling the protestor and dragging him away.

The reason why Boebert is spreading this theory is because it dehumanizes her political opponents and primes her base to accept and participate in violence committed against them.
It's the same reason why she claims that Trans people are behind a wave of mass shootings or that Ilhan Omar is a jihadi.
Democrats, LGBTQ, Muslims, and Jews all groups she is targeting she wants violence committed against them. She is pushing for it at a policy level and she is priming her base for it.
We have a rapidly closing window to fire her before she escalates America's epidemic of political violence past the point of no return.
Lauren Boebert is in Congress because of a mere 546 votes. In 2024 when labor leader Trisha Calvarese went head to head with her, Trisha had the best performance a Democrat has ever had in this district while Boebert underperformed Trump in every county. Now Trisha is back to finish the job.

_**By David Shuster**_
It was never enough for Donald Trump to defile decency, throttle the Constitution, and drag the presidency through every trough of vulgarity known to humanity. Now Trump is completing the desecration by turning the White House--_the People 's House_--into a gaudy Versailles knock-off, built not for governance, but for garish galas, self-worship, and pay-for-play corruption on steroids.
By now, you have probably heard about Trump's latest White House obscenity - **bulldozing the entire historic East Wing** to start construction on a ballroom annex.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6574fadb-38e5-4691-98f2-492f9e3733bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Lost in the disturbing images, the fine print details get even worse. Most architects and designers hate the Trump ballroom blueprints and plans, never mind that the process Trump has pursued is against the law.
Start with the architects. They call the Trump ballroom plan "tacky and horrifying." And that's putting it gently.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd0709ca-e083-41fe-8397-3838f8da9341?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/09acb5de-4aa1-45e2-bbd8-f1387f572635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
The 90,000 square foot structure will dwarf the existing 50,000 square foot White House, rupturing the symmetry and solemnity with a giant slab of neoclassical fakery.
The garish and ostentatious Trump ballroom will be the spiritual sibling of a Las Vegas hotel lobby (if Vegas had a dictator wing).
The architect responsible for the controversial ballroom design and overseeing the destruction/construction is a Trump friend - James McCrery.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd2cead-fc28-4862-a2fa-10c56cfcceb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
McCrery specializes in religious architecture, with a portfolio that includes cathedrals in Tennessee, North Carolina, and Texas. Whatever. The American Institute of Architects recently sent a letter to the Committee for the Preservation of the White House, politely urging "adjustments that would align the proposed additions with the White House's historic character. "
McCrery's former mentor, famed architect Peter Eisenman, was less diplomatic. Eisenman called the McCrery design "bonkers" and said, "putting a portico at the end of a long façade and not in the center is what one might say is untutored."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/89d5b2ec-7afe-496e-a426-585a0a402f33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
#### ** 💥 Support fearless journalism that calls out corruption.💥
20% off memberships today.**
[Help Tear Down the Golden Cage.](https://substack.com/redirect/09acb5de-4aa1-45e2-bbd8-f1387f572635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Design critic Christopher Hawthorne was even more blunt. He said, "the ballroom design, a big-footed architectural presence stomping toward the southern edge of the White House grounds, violates the very standards of beauty and proportion that McCrery loves to rhapsodize about in interviews, to say nothing of the protocols long in place to guide changes to 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue."
Those protocols are also the law. And under the law, all changes or modifications to any federal government building, including the White House, must be reviewed and approved by the National Capital Planning Commission.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/70fe17a5-87c8-4376-8b42-65fec90417ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump began demolishing the East Wing before giving the NCPC any submission or even communication about his McCrery plans.
Once again, the law is something for Trump to mock, evade, or rewrite, depending on which marble pillar stands in the way of His Orange Excellency's vision.
**This isn 't renovation. It's imperial cosplay.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/993e9190-0393-4973-937c-c152f68da6d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And like countless imperialistic authoritarians before him, Old Man Orange keeps lying. A few months ago, Trump insisted that no part of the existing White House would be affected or touched by the ballroom project. Now, the entire east wing -- built in 1902 and home to the First Lady's office, protocol staff, and visitors center -- is being flattened.
There has been no review, no oversight, and not a peep from Republicans in Congress.
Because God forbid a GOP lawmaker dares to speak the Truth about his Majesty. And the truth is that Trump has always treated public office like a failing casino -- drain the coffers, plaster your name in gold, and leave the wreckage behind for someone else to clean up.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ef081e72-9f0e-49d2-9137-41cc8fc99321?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now Trump seeks to embed that pathology in stone and steel, building a party palace on sacred civic ground as if the White House were Mar-a-Lago North. The cost? Reportedly, a quarter of a billion dollars, supposedly from private donors. Who are these donors, and what will they expect in return -- aside from invitations to waltz under chandeliers in the shadow of constitutional collapse? Trump won't say.
Don't be distracted by the ornate gold and champagne flutes.
* * *
#### ** 💥 Support fearless journalism that calls out corruption.💥
20% off memberships today.**
[No Kings. No Ballrooms. No Bullshit.](https://substack.com/redirect/09acb5de-4aa1-45e2-bbd8-f1387f572635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2f087bae-28e6-4889-acac-2c247e6d30ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This project is not about events or hospitality. It is about permanence. The ballroom is an architectural IOU to Trump's own ego -- a monument not to America, but to a man who has never loved anything but his own reflection.
The symbolism is no less nauseating. At a time when democracy teeters, when citizens scrape to make ends meet, Trump wishes to pour gold leaf over the ruins of our civic trust. He is Nero with a spray tan, fiddling with blueprints as Rome rots.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3ae38ddd-8cdd-41be-8e25-fcc5951bd5df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
** 🏛️💔 Furious about the East Wing? 🏛️💔 Us too! Join us!**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.6Nj8hmkq05xw_bkmD6Qx0Ws0z24g4z--37aq71M-ryA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=176888047)
* * *
Trump, ever the confidence man, understands one thing with brutal clarity: if you act with enough brazenness (along with a Republican House/Senate and a Conservative majority Supreme Court), the rules will dissolve before you.
And so we must ask: Is there any line Trump cannot or will not cross? If the literal foundations of the White House are not safe from his gaudy ambitions, what is?
If George Washington weeps, he weeps not because a ballroom is being built, but because the presidency has been hijacked by a man who views governance as nothing more than a red carpet opportunity for self-promotion, self-dealing, and family enrichment.
Trump's White House ballroom is not a national project. It is a desecration -- a monument to delusion, designed by sycophants, enabled by silence, and built on the demolished bones of law and legacy.
Let history record that when the People's House was defiled, most conservatives watched in silence as a clown king prepared to build his golden cage.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ebfa4ba4-774a-499b-b3da-5b03288519b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But there will be a reckoning. Former Republican Congressman Joe Walsh is urging Democratic Presidential candidates to run on tearing down Trump's ballroom abomination. Hear hear.
#### Democrats should pledge to make it a public celebration. Invite all Americans to come to Washington, D.C., with sledgehammers and crowbars for a weekend after the 2029 inauguration.
(_If we are lucky enough to have a free/fair election in 2028_).
Cleansing our nation of Trumpism -- emotionally, politically, culturally, and physically -- will be long and arduous.
Now is the time, though -- for our own sanity -- to start making the plans.
The Trump ballroom, like so much else Trump is inflicting, must not be allowed to stand.
* * *

body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=3049%2E582294%2EH_tokJ ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=3049%2E582294%2EH_tokJ ]Chris Pappas for Senate

John Sununu officially jumped into the race for U.S. Senate in New
Hampshire — a move orchestrated by national Republicans desperate to cling
to power.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251023_1_sununu.c_ks5R&refcode=em20251023-1&t=1003&akid=3049%2E582294%2EH_tokJ ]I need your help to fight back against this latest opponent, win this
race, and keep New Hampshire blue. Will you rush a contribution today?

Our opponents know our grassroots movement threatens everything they stand
for: cashing in with corporations, working for special interests, and
selling out New Hampshire.

I will take on anyone to do what’s best for New Hampshire, and I’ll keep
fighting to make health care more affordable, protect Granite Staters’
hard-earned benefits, and defend reproductive freedom.

National Republicans are going to throw everything at us to flip this seat
– including recruiting a former one-term Senator like Sununu, who made
millions after selling out New Hampshire to corporations and working for
special interests. We must protect this seat if Democrats want any shot at
flipping the Senate and putting a stop to the GOP’s extreme agenda. But we
can’t do it without you.

With Sununu officially in, this Senate race just became one of the most
competitive and expensive in the country, and GOP megadonors and corporate
PACs are already lining up to flip this seat red. Now it’s up to us to
fight back.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251023_1_sununu.c_ks5R&refcode=em20251023-1&t=1004&akid=3049%2E582294%2EH_tokJ ]Can you chip in today to power this movement and defend this Senate
seat?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251023_1_sununu.c_ks5R&amount=5&refcode=em20251023-1&t=1023&akid=3049%2E582294%2EH_tokJ ]Donate $5 »

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=3049%2E582294%2EH_tokJ

Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *
| | | | [](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4l6gv&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4l6gv&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4l6gv&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4l6gv&__onlt=h)
---

---

---

---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4l6gv&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4l6gv&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4l6gv&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?xtl=71kqox8yyg2cp929r125s8j6nes5tw1h3iulhivpggbcfwuymzkttrs6f9i5lcb4h3bdmjncdpolmco69dzl92e4hw4ywc26g033ejyedkveaycmim1saf0x3bfsjobxafi2gud6x2niyfdeec5f&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4l6gv&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**

Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏

The billionaire class is no longer satisfied with controlling legislation and bankrolling politicians; they want to be completely untouchable and unaccountable, free to accumulate wealth without legal consequences.

Dear Friend of Religious Liberty, Because of your voice, Camp IdRaHaJe can continue to live out its Christian faith--free from government coercion. Praise God! When Colorado officials tried to force the camp to allow males in girls' private spaces, Camp IdRaHaJe didn't cave. It stood firm on its biblical convictions--and said, "We'd rather have Jesus." And you stood with the camp. Thousands signed the public statement of support. The outcry was heard. Colorado backed down. **Today, Camp IdRaHaJe remains a place where kids across the state can encounter the hope of the Gospel without compromise.** _**But the battle for truth and freedom isn 't over.**_ In Vermont, the girls' basketball team at Mid Vermont Christian School (MVCS) chose faith over fear--and paid a price. Faced with the prospect of competing against a team that included a male who identifies as female, the school declined to play. The school and its families honored their biblical beliefs about God's design for males and females. In response, **Vermont officials banned every MVCS middle and high school student from participating in all state-sponsored sports. Every student --benched.** This punishment has lasted two years. And it continues.
