| Letter from the Chair
---
Over the past three weeks, I've reflected on the government shutdown and its uneven impact. For me, the effects have been minor--an inability to schedule an in-person IRS meeting to clarify some minor tax issues. Beyond that, my daily life feels untouched. But the news paints a starkly different picture: countless Americans reliant on government services and many federal workers are struggling. Why has this shutdown hit so hard?
Historically, government shutdowns--or threats of them--have been temporary. Reason typically prevails, and Congress passes a Continuing Resolution to kick the funding can down the road. Yet this time feels different. A political power struggle within the Democratic Party seems to be at the heart of the impasse. Senator Chuck Schumer (D-NY) is reportedly clashing with rising figures like Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-NY), who may challenge him in a 2028 primary. Some call this "Schumer's shutdown," pointing to personal ambition overshadowing the nation's needs.
This dynamic isn't unique to politics. It mirrors a lesson often shared with parents after a bitter divorce: "Love your child more than you hate your ex." Too often, ego, power, status, or acclaim take precedence over the greater good. We see it in personal conflicts, workplaces, and now, Congress.
Contrast this with those who prioritize service over self. Our military men and women, who sacrifice everything, embody this principle. Figures like Charlie Kirk or President Trump, who could have chosen comfort but pursued public service instead, challenge us to rethink our priorities.
This shutdown is a moment for reflection. Why are we here? What drives our leaders--and us? Perhaps it's time to put the greater good above personal gain, to serve rather than to conquer.

Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair Over the past three weeks, I've reflected on the government shutdown and its uneven impact. For me, the effects have been minor--an inability to schedule an in-person IRS meeting to clarify some minor tax issues. Beyond that, my daily life feels untouched. But the news paints a starkly different picture: countless Americans reliant on government services and many federal workers are struggling. Why has this shutdown hit so hard? Historically, government shutdowns--or threats of them--have been temporary. Reason typically prevails, and Congress passes a Continuing Resolution to kick the funding can down the road. Yet this time feels different. A political power struggle within the Democratic Party seems to be at the heart of the impasse. Senator Chuck Schumer (D-NY) is reportedly clashing with rising figures like Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-NY), who may challenge him in a 2028 primary. Some call this "Schumer's shutdown," pointing to personal ambition overshadowing the nation's needs. This dynamic isn't unique to politics. It mirrors a lesson often shared with parents after a bitter divorce: "Love your child more than you hate your ex." Too often, ego, power, status, or acclaim take precedence over the greater good. We see it in personal conflicts, workplaces, and now, Congress. Contrast this with those who prioritize service over self. Our military men and women, who sacrifice everything, embody this principle. Figures like Charlie Kirk or President Trump, who could have chosen comfort but pursued public service instead, challenge us to rethink our priorities. This shutdown is a moment for reflection. Why are we here? What drives our leaders--and us? Perhaps it's time to put the greater good above personal gain, to serve rather than to conquer. But I can't ignore the millions of dollars Dems are prepared to spend against me because I'm running in the heart of **MAGA Country.**

_Long story short, I can 't win this on my own._

_**Look - money was always tight in my household.**_ A missed paycheck could mean less food on the dinner table for the whole family.

So I know how much a few dollars means to many Americans.

name: Kamala Harris
subject: A different request
body:
Please split a donation between my work and Planned Parenthood today.

Peter —
My mother had two goals in life: To raise my sister Maya and me, and to cure breast cancer.
My mother’s work led to significant breakthroughs in breast cancer research. I too have dedicated a large part of my work to supporting scientific research and organizations that address some of the great pains people experience.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-ftp-pp?refcode=em251023-a&refcode2=771_2563979_qxw7in&akid=771%2E2563979%2Eqxw7in)
This Breast Cancer Awareness month — and every month — I honor my mother’s research and the millions of others impacted by this disease.
[**If you would like to join me, please split a donation between my work and Planned Parenthood today. subject: Former CDC Director and Top Voices Join This Week’sMAHA Media Hub
body:
Without you, we have no shot at fixing our broken food and health systems.

| | | [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com/?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=1)

---
**Dear MAHA Warriors,** Each week, we come together through the MAHA Media Hub to regroup, share progress, and focus on what matters most for the movement ahead. The biggest names in MAHA continue to join because they know what’s at stake — and what happens if we stop pushing.
### If you didn’t catch the call, here’s what some of our key speakers had to say:
* **Dr. Robert Redfield** , CDC Director under President Trump, said mandating the Covid vaccine was a major mistake and that rebuilding trust starts with honesty.

* **Tony Robbins** spoke about how you don’t need a huge following to make a difference — every post and every share helps grow this movement.

* **Dr. Robert Malone** discussed how the Hepatitis B birth dose is no longer supported by current evidence and why informed consent must always come first.

* **Sayer Ji** highlighted that trust in mainstream media is collapsing, and the people’s voices are finally breaking through.

* **Farmer Joel Salatin** shared how real health — for both people and animals — comes from working with nature, not against it.

As always, our speakers focused on different issues, but each message tied back to one goal: **making America healthy again**.
---
[ ](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=1AJnCcoGtHYftrUTYBwtFCx8DyQCP1kqjikxsNlK4edlei2yt75SOR4YL3mYZR5I&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=2)
---
## Action Items
### 1\. Keep Sharing the MAHA Message
Policy no longer comes from corporate boardrooms — it comes from people like you. Every post, every share, every conversation moves this mission forward.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=42XIdAn1v5Cn5XbOMM8Dv1DijiQgVHk9pl1Ff-uIxlq0ur8ivjl4kCzP_xba-bq4MdC3gJI6Wgfq10EUyxkOI3eun7MjGRK2SYrFPtRNXlF2AbWttU87P0fZwj2Q0uSv-VaIQbwZ3D1eBdi_aRY_BA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=3 "DOWNLOAD ALL RESOURCES") [DOWNLOAD ALL RESOURCES](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=42XIdAn1v5Cn5XbOMM8Dv1DijiQgVHk9pl1Ff-uIxlq0ur8ivjl4kCzP_xba-bq4MdC3gJI6Wgfq10EUyxkOI3eun7MjGRK2SYrFPtRNXlF2AbWttU87P0fZwj2Q0uSv-VaIQbwZ3D1eBdi_aRY_BA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=3)
---
### 2\. Exposing Big Food and Big Pharma
Big Food just launched Americans for Ingredient Transparency, a fake “consumer” group designed to block state bans on harmful additives. 👉 [Read Food Babe’s report](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=ZUQdHL0arhzqg9ayx7cJ79feCssCyrsSz-6F6g2CAC1dX_zVmmoYsugSABB3gw3V4O0sdutOOkJwRf56UbhXYX3HMgPHuhjshiAtkUUmP98taqEcoz2nLEAa7DMJHyK0&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=4)
### 3\. Watch Toxic Nation — A Film by MAHATM
Toxic Nation reveals how toxins have quietly invaded our food, air, and water — and lays out MAHA’s blueprint to take our health back. 🎬 [Watch for free at toxicnation.mahafilms.com](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=SvJT2eC3_X38ZYoooap2ddRQrSCtTPlIwqd7jqRI0OZYTmoUG31BBoVWYc00OJcA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=5)
### 4\. Subscribe to _The MAHA Report_
Your go-to source for real, uncensored reporting on the issues shaping health freedom. Each week, MAHA’s writers dig into stories the mainstream won’t touch — with facts, transparency, and clear takeaways. 📰 [Subscribe on Substack](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=CjIPhRT4CzYYH7usCPIijxK54GDZUZAqQjCCk5hNXuc&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=6)
### 5\. MAHA Goes Global
The MAHA message is spreading across Europe as doctors and citizens abroad join the fight for medical and food freedom. Saving our children isn’t political — it’s something we all agree with. [MEHA – Make Europe Healthy Again](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=DNzpWVVmYtwo6DuufHEHZcF6MMIb0jCX1cpVoNSriHo&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=7)
### 6\. Stand for Health Freedom — Take Action Now[ __](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=CjIPhRT4CzYYH7usCPIijxK54GDZUZAqQjCCk5hNXuc&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=8)
**Support the Clear Skies Act**
Americans are being sprayed without warning or consent through weather modification programs like geoengineering and cloud seeding. Demand transparency and accountability. 🗳️ [Take action now](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=gYUPsZlV8vQD3dzXxGaMj-SUMeW-TJmJOB-9bPZ2kaDvPTni-A0X4HS_aZHRmV2WMHbnaHgqaNO80MSi5iBUhA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=9) **Pull Unsafe Covid Shots from the Market**
Four years later, evidence continues to grow about safety concerns and underreported injuries. Demand oversight and transparency now. 📢 [Take action now](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=gYUPsZlV8vQD3dzXxGaMj-SUMeW-TJmJOB-9bPZ2kaBea2oeGEmJe9UjOS0p0FN435kwp4G_TXyqAagXT1MJSA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=10) **Prepare for Midterms — Health Freedom Depends on It**
Midterms will decide whether Secretary Kennedy can continue his reform work. Send the health freedom candidate survey to your local candidates — your voice matters most. [🗳️ Vote for Health Freedom Candidate Survey](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=gYUPsZlV8vQD3dzXxGaMj-SUMeW-TJmJOB-9bPZ2kaBXAT0Nlx6V7ZxLbTDcowR1srvbCuvnbYQUszagT-vbbA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=11)
### 7\. Support Changing the Dietary Guidelines
Dietary guidelines shape what families, schools, and hospitals view as “healthy.” MAHA leaders like Nina Teicholz have pushed for years to bring real food back to the plate. 🌾 [Learn more at lowcarbmaha.org](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=74V-TL2FxRmRj4Ghz_ffSqLjrycO3buo-YyCk7nX1II&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=12)
### 8\. The Pesticide Immunity Shield
Congress is preparing a Farm Bill that would give chemical companies immunity from lawsuits and strip states of their ability to regulate pesticides. 📞 [Call your representatives now](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=4OpapyABMkIfQDTWg-zeF1CJdpObTKtVmaXukLMCcFCZt9wfm40nHirBIOLzwowyxDa7GuFPL7iNBdLfZVEVXA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=13)
### 9\. Take a Look at MAHA Action’s New Legislative Tracker
The new MAHA Legislative Tracker makes it easier than ever to take action and influence real policy change. 🔗 [Explore the Legislative Tracker](https://www.mahaaction.com/lawmakers?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251023_engaged&n=14)
## Before You Go
The everyday supporter keeps this mission alive — because without you, we have no shot at fixing our broken food and health systems. Thank you for staying loud, engaged, and relentless. See you next week,
The MAHA Action Team

Breaking news, Peter:

Justice Democrats just made our fourth endorsement of the 2026 cycle, and
she’s a familiar face: progressive champion and former Rep. Cori Bush!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20251023-cb.-j8tkC&refcode=em20251023-37132&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37132%2E1203867%2ETtzQSZ ]Justice Democrats 2026 Endorsed: Cori Bush for U.S. Congress MO-01

Cori became the first-ever Justice Democrat in 2017 during her first
campaign for Congress, and has had Justice Democrats’ support in every
cycle since then.

Now, we’re proud to have Cori’s back again as she takes on AIPAC-backed
Rep. Wesley Bell in a rematch for Missouri’s 1st congressional district.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20251023-cb.-j8tkC&refcode=em20251023-37132&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37132%2E1203867%2ETtzQSZ ]Rush a split contribution of $5 or more to fuel Justice
Democrats and Cori’s people-powered campaign now!

We at Team JD have proudly been with Cori since her first congressional
race in 2017 because she is a fighter. Since then, she has redefined what
it means to bring true urgency and power for poor and working people to
Washington.

During her first run for Congress, Cori was a single mom, registered
nurse, and pastor who played a pivotal role on the frontlines of the Black
Lives Matter movement in Ferguson after the police killing of Michael
Brown. Despite losing her first primary, she came back in 2020 to defeat
an entrenched corporate incumbent, ending a 50-year political dynasty that
had stopped working for the people of St. Louis.

On just her third day in Congress, she took immediate action to hold
members of Congress responsible for inciting the January 6 insurrection
and demanded their expulsion. In her first term, Cori exemplified a new
generation of leadership, introducing visionary legislation like the Green
New Deal for Cities and the People’s Response Act to transform public
safety.

When the national eviction moratorium was going to expire during the
COVID-19 pandemic, Cori slept on the steps of the Capitol until the Biden
administration extended it. In Congress, she became one of the Democratic
Party’s leading voices for abortion rights and reproductive justice, even
testifying with her own abortion story in the House Oversight Committee
and leading a statewide tour to educate Missourians about their abortion
rights in response to the state’s extreme ban.

In the wake of Israel’s genocide in Gaza, Cori led the original Ceasefire
Now resolution to demand an immediate ceasefire in Palestine, galvanizing
millions across the world and an overwhelming majority of voters in the US
to demand a ceasefire. Of course, that drew the attention of the powerful
anti-Palestinian lobby.

Last cycle, AIPAC teamed up with corporate-aligned PACs like Crypto’s
Fairshake and Reid Hoffman’s Mainstream Democrats to spend over $12
million to defeat Cori in what was the second-most expensive House primary
ever. Since then, AIPAC’s brand amongst Democratic Party voters and even
establishment Democrats has substantially deteriorated while they
unsuccessfully try to rehabilitate their image as a pro-genocide lobby
that buys politicians.

In this new environment, with the majority of Democratic voters tired of
establishment elected officials like Wesley Bell giving unconditional
support to a genocide, Cori and our movement can take on AIPAC and WIN
this time.

At the end of the day, Cori is one of the most working-class voices we’ve
had in Congress, and now more than ever, St. Louis and our nation need
more voices of conscience who will stand up for what’s right for all
people. That couldn’t be clearer, especially as Wesley Bell has repeatedly
proven he’s willing to bend to Trump’s donors and the billionaire class
that has ushered in the authoritarianism and corporate greed we see now.

# **JD Vance slams Jen Psaki 's 'disgraceful' remarks about his wife fearing him**
Vice President JD Vance **[called MSNBC host Jen Psaki's comments about second lady Usha Vance "disgraceful"](https://substack.com/redirect/c2666f4c-4032-448e-af8a-b536f20d2a79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after she appeared on a podcast suggesting Usha is afraid of her husband, saying "Are you OK? # **Illegal immigrant arrested in deadly California crash**
Jashanpreet Singh, a 21-year-old illegal immigrant from India who crossed the southern border in March 2022 and **[was released by the Biden administration pending an immigration hearing,](https://substack.com/redirect/12d702cf-fa6e-45a4-849b-7e793e3c6a34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** has been arrested on suspicion of gross vehicular manslaughter while intoxicated after his semi-truck plowed into slow-moving traffic on the I-10 Freeway in San Bernardino County.

* **Cuomo haunted by past scandals:** Despite a stronger performance than the first debate, Cuomo struggled to address the 13 women who accused him of sexual harassment--including Charlotte Bennett, who attended as part of a Mamdani-organized stunt--while Mamdani cast him as "Donald Trump's puppet" and blamed his "experience" for New Yorkers' woes on housing, the MTA, and nursing home deaths.
* **Sliwa 's strong showing complicates anti-Mamdani strategy:** Political strategist Andrew Kirtzman noted this was "Mamdani's weakest performance this cycle" but warned that Cuomo's problem is he "needed both of them to have a bad night," and with Sliwa having a "terrific night" despite calls for him to drop out, "there is no way Cuomo can win" with 13 days until the November 4 election.

Trump wants taxpayers to pay him hundreds of millions of dollars because law enforcement dared to hold him accountable. | Even worse: the DOJ officials now deciding whether to give him that money are his former defense lawyers -- the same people who used to represent him in court. This isn't just corruption. It's self-dealing on a historic scale. Trump's demand dwarfs payouts to actual victims -- families of the Sutherland Springs shooting, survivors of Larry Nassar's abuse, and the Mother Emanuel church massacre. All received less than what Trump claims he's "owed." And if his DOJ agrees to the settlement, we pay the bill. Every taxpayer. Every working family. Every person who still believes presidents should serve the people -- not the other way around. Trump's greed has no bottom. While millions suffer from his shutdown over healthcare, he's trying to turn public service into a personal payday. No Dem Left Behind is fighting back -- exposing Trump's corruption, organizing in battlegrounds, and working to elect leaders who put people before power. Because America deserves justice -- not a golden payout for corruption. -- No Dem Left Behind | | Mail checks to: No Dem Left Behind 1030 15th St NW #404 Washington, DC 20005 | Paid for by No Dem Left Behind PAC Not Authorized by Any Federal Candidate or Candidate's Committee. | | Sent via . body:
#
Peter,
Football season is in full swing, the Gophers are looking good (Row the Boat!) and the Vikings are showing some real potential.
And while I’d love to just chat football with you, Peter, I wanted to relay how some of my experience as a football coach has taught me how to govern.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/94?t=1&akid=21%2E34582%2EoYl-UM)
As a former defensive coordinator at Mankato West High School, I learned a lot about what bringing a team together looks like — and how it can defend against a variety of attacks — whether it be a pass heavy offense, or a ground and pound offense.
And Peter, that’s what we're up against in Minnesota right now. **The Trump administration and his allies are throwing everything they’ve got at us with attacks coming from all angles.**
But I know that we’ve built a team here in Minnesota that is ready to fight back and defend our rights and freedoms. As One Minnesota, we’re ready to stand up to the Trump administration and his MAGA cronies regardless what they throw our way.
**But we have to stick together.**
A good team will always have each other's backs, and I need you to have mine.

Tim Walz

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks,
We can't believe it either, but President Trump announced furloughed federal workers may never get the paychecks they lost during his shutdown. He thinks some “don’t deserve” it. That’s right — the people who inspect our food, care for veterans, and protect our national parks are being told they might never be paid for weeks of missed work. It’s cruel, it’s unprecedented, and it’s wrong.
Congress has the power to fix this right now by passing emergency legislation guaranteeing every furloughed worker full back pay — no exceptions, no excuses. Every previous Congress has made workers whole once the government reopened. But now Trump is breaking that promise — using everyday workers as political pawns.
Experts told ABC News this move is “ punitive and unprecedented .” And they’re right. Families have missed rent, drained savings, and lined up at food banks — all because of political games from a billionaire president who’s never had to worry about a paycheck. We can’t let Trump get away with this attack on working people.

Hey there,
With less than two weeks left until Election Day, our team has been reminiscing on our time on the campaign trail.
In Lynchburg a few months ago, Jay stopped by Virginia Episcopal School — the same school his dad helped integrate in the 1960s. It was a powerful reminder of how far Virginia has come, and how much work is still ahead to ensure every child has a fair shot.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-update-em_q42025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-update-em_q42025]
In Bristol, Jay grabbed a burger at the Burger Bar, a small, family-owned spot that’s been serving the community for generations. It’s the kind of place that makes Virginia, Virginia — where folks look out for each other and take pride in where they’re from.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-update-em_q42025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-update-em_q42025]
In Buena Vista, Jay spoke at the 54th Annual Labor Fest, standing shoulder to shoulder with the working people who built this Commonwealth and keep it running every day.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-update-em_q42025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-update-em_q42025]
In Charlottesville, Jay spent time tailgating with folks before the UVA-William & Mary game. As an alum of both schools, it was a reminder that no matter where we come from, we all share a love for this Commonwealth and its people.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-update-em_q42025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-update-em_q42025]
And just this week, Jay’s been out canvassing with members of the AFL-CIO and the Norfolk Federation of Teachers. He’s talking with the folks who are shaping Virginia’s future every single day and having meaningful conversations about the issues that matter most.
From classrooms to diners, factory floors to football fields, these moments of connection are what keep Jay going. This campaign isn’t about politics — it’s about people. It’s about protecting our rights, lowering costs, and making sure every Virginian has the opportunity to thrive.
With Election Day fast approaching, every conversation, every volunteer shift, and every contribution makes a real difference. Can you chip in today to help Jay finish strong? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-update-em_q42025]

name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is so good
body:
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.

* * *
| | | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=2vytyz4021zn4ma5f9be4p4f8dnysb93thjabug8bto3q91ds6azqa1l66otyeryp3h0tt7s8u5at6f88o70ahfcxl8g8r6zdmfk7au9h9yy37zaj7jdzx8n5xjr2f108farn9cq7td&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lbil&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---

Phoenix, Arizona 85044
---

subject: This isn't just a campaign. It's home.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GARY MILLER FOR DELEGATE** 121 Bell Ct
body:
We are fighting for Dr. Gary Miller because his candidacy isn't just politics to us, it's personal.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f1025c1cf020/this-isnt-just-a-campaign-its-home?e=606d7e9aa2)
---
| | | | |

[|
---](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=ff1b359097&e=606d7e9aa2)
| | Friend,
My name is Josh, and I'm Dr. Gary Miller's campaign manager. Long before I started working in politics, I was just a kid growing up right here in Southside Virginia. This place, **its struggles, its resilience, and its heart are woven into who I am**.
For years, working on campaigns across the state and country, I held onto a dream: to one day come home and run a race staffed entirely by talented, **dedicated professionals who were** _**from here**_**.** People who didn't just understand the district on paper, but who lived its challenges and celebrated its victories because it was _their_ community, too.
Today, that dream is real. **Our entire team is from Danville, Pittsylvania, or Halifax.** We are the home team. We are fighting for Dr. Gary Miller because his candidacy isn't just another election for us. It's personal.
It's about electing a leader who has spent 36 years healing our neighbors as a doctor. Someone who stepped up to serve on City Council not for ambition, but because **he saw families hurting and knew he had to do more**. Someone who will go to Richmond and fight to keep our local hospital open, because he knows **what happens when care is hours away.** Someone who will fight for our public schools, because like his own mother, sister, and wife, he knows **teachers deserve our respect and support.**
This campaign is about protecting the place we call home and the people we love. It's about ensuring Southside Virginia has a voice in Richmond that truly understands us, that shares our values, and that will **never stop fighting for what is right, no matter who you are or where you call home.**
We are the underdogs in this race. **Our opponent is backed by inherited connections and MAGA extremists trying to buy this seat.** We have something they don't: the heart and soul of this community.
We are running a smart, aggressive campaign built on grassroots energy and professionals who happen to be local. To compete with the outside money flooding into this district from **Dominion Power, Altria** , and others, we need your help right now.
**Will you stand with the home team? Will you invest in a campaign run by, for, and dedicated to the people of Southside Virginia? Your contribution today fuels our fight.**
[**[Chip in $25 to support the hometeam]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=a6cc8384ca&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Chip in $50 to fight back]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=36195d6c7b&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Chip in $100 to help us win]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=828940dd54&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Or contribute another amount]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=448dba18e0&e=606d7e9aa2)
Campaigns come and go, but home is forever. Thank you for believing in our team and for helping us bring this one home for Southside and our great Commonwealth.
Solidarity forever,
Josh Norris
Campaign Manager
Gary Miller for House of Delegates

You’ll hear directly from:

* Kimberly Fletcher, Moms for America Founder and President

* Debbie Kraulidis, Moms for America Vice President

* Cassie Fletcher, Moms for America Director of Education

Together, we’ll talk about the movement sweeping the nation, practical ways you can take action in your community, and how YOU can
be part of restoring faith, family, and freedom in America.

It's time for a Cultural Revival!

Whether you’re brand new to Moms for America or you’ve been with us for years, this is your moment to step into the action.

Register below to reserve your spot, and join us Thursday night!

America is stirring. The mission is clear. And the time is now. Will you join us?

With faith, family, and freedom,
The Moms for America Team

[] [] Join Us October 30th For the Live Fireside Chat with Kimberly & Debbie 5:00PM PT / 6:00 PM MT / 7:00 PM CT / 8:00 PM ET Something has shifted in our nation. In the wake of recent events, Americans everywhere are feeling the fire and a renewed urgency to stand, to speak, and to engage. We know you’re feeling it too. That’s why we’re inviting you to join us Thursday, October 30th for a special LIVE Moms for America Fireside Chat. This is not a time to sit on the sidelines. It’s a moment to rise together, and you don’t want to miss it. You’ll hear directly from: Kimberly Fletcher, Moms for America Founder and President Debbie Kraulidis, Moms for America Vice President * Cassie Fletcher, Moms for America Director of Education Together, we’ll talk about the movement sweeping the nation, practical ways you can take action in your community, and how YOU can be part of restoring faith, family, and freedom in America. It's time for a Cultural Revival! Whether you’re brand new to Moms for America or you’ve been with us for years, this is your moment to step into the action. Register below to reserve your spot, and join us Thursday night! America is stirring. The mission is clear. And the time is now. Will you join us? (Ashlee Rezin/Sun-Times)
By Illinois Review

Republican gubernatorial candidate and former Illinois State Senator Darren Bailey is mourning an unimaginable loss after a helicopter crash in Montana claimed the lives of his son, daughter-in-law, and two grandchildren.

According to a statement from the Bailey/Del Mar campaign, the tragedy occurred Wednesday evening. Bailey’s son, Zachary, his wife, Kelsey, and their two children – 12-year-old Vada Rose and 7-year-old Samuel – were on board the helicopter when it went down. All four were killed in the crash.

Their 10-year-old son, Finn, was not on the flight and is safe, the campaign confirmed.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/10/heartbreak-for-darren-bailey-son-daughter-in-law-and-grandchildren-killed-in-montana-helicopter-crash.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=17aebfc370-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
(Photo provided by the Bailey/DelMar Campaign)
“Darren and Cindy are heartbroken by this unimaginable loss,” the statement read. “They are finding comfort in their faith, their family, and the prayers of so many who love and care for them.”

Bailey, the 2022 Republican nominee for governor and current GOP candidate for 2026, is known for his strong Christian faith and commitment to family values. The campaign has asked the public to keep the Bailey family in their prayers as they grieve this devastating loss.

If you knew that $7 would help Democrats defeat attacks from MAGA billionaires who are trying to fill our courts, the last line of defense against Trump’s agenda, with MAGA extremists, wouldn’t it feel like the most worthwhile donation you’ve ever made? And if we told you that your $7 donation would support our grassroots team of volunteers and staff _on the ground_ in Pennsylvania who are working day in and day out to reach voters statewide, make sure they’re hearing Democrats’ message, and ultimately are prepared to elect leaders from school boards to the state legislature to Congress, wouldn’t you click the link below to give $7 _right now_? **Derek, these questions aren’t just fictional scenarios — this is the work that we’re able to do in Pennsylvania with the backing of grassroots supporters like you.** Your $7 donation helps us invest in organizing in every Pennsylvania ZIP code, support all our candidates with the resources they need to win, and elect Democrats who will fight for working families in our communities, while stopping Trump and his allies from further eroding our democracy. ** NEW PATRIOT PACK
------------------------------------------------------------
INCLUDES: TRAVEL CASE, CUTTER & CIGARS!

The Patriot Pack — Smoke for the Bold and the Free

Stand tall and light up freedom with The Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company — a powerful lineup built for true American patriots. Featuring The “Pledge” Premium Leather 3-Cigar Travel Case, the Old Glory Cigar Cutter, and three powerhouse blends — TNT, MOAB, and Sidewinder — this set is your all-American arsenal of premium, hand-rolled cigars. Crafted for quality. Fueled by liberty. Made for those who never back down.
https://mypatriotcigars.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3ea77f33fc36dd7515163e71c&id=de2a882da7&e=fbf55fa623

**
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Patriot Pack
A Bold Salute to Liberty
------------------------------------------------------------

Raise your colors high — the Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company is the ultimate tribute to freedom, made for those who stand proud. This isn’t just a cigar set; it’s a declaration, a statement, and a smoke-filled salute to the red, white, and blue.

** Included Inside the Patriot Pack
------------------------------------------------------------

**
“The Pledge” Premium Leather 3-Cigar Travel Case
------------------------------------------------------------

Carry your cigars in patriotic style. This rugged yet elegant case is crafted in premium printed leather with the pledge of allegiance, built to safeguard your Patriot Cigars while projecting staunch American pride. Designed for travel, with room for three cigars up to a 60-ring size and a secure closure, it’s more than storage—it’s armor for your freedom smoke.

** Old Glory Cigar Cutter
------------------------------------------------------------

No patriot’s toolkit is complete without a sharp edge. The Old Glory Cigar Cutter is a dual-blade instrument worthy of the name. It slices clean and precise, honoring the flag with every snip (and making sure your draw is perfect).
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Finest Blends Under the Flag
------------------------------------------------------------

** TNT
------------------------------------------------------------

Explosive in flavor and bold in character, TNT is a powerhouse medium to full blend that commands your attention. From first light to the last ember, it burns with authority.

** MOAB (Mother of All Bombs)
------------------------------------------------------------

MOAB delivers a full-bodied punch, a maduro cigar that lives up to its name. Deep, rich, and intense — this is not for the faint of heart but for the true patriot who demands maximum firepower in flavor.

** Sidewinder
------------------------------------------------------------

Sleek, swift, and sly — the Sidewinder rounds out the pack with a medium blend that strikes with finesse. Balanced, bold, and full of character, it’s the curveball every patriotic smoker needs.

The Patriot Pack doesn’t stop there, you’ll also get a Patriot-branded beverage koozie, coaster, sticker, and patch—because every smoke session deserves a touch of American pride.
------------------------------------------------------------

** Why the Patriot Pack Matters
------------------------------------------------------------

This is not merely a sampler or gift set. The Patriot Pack is your on-demand arsenal of American spirit and premium craftsmanship. It’s a perfect companion for travel, a striking gift for fellow flag-bearers, or your own daily reminder that freedom is worth celebrating — one premium puff at a time.

Light up The Patriot Pack. Puff with pride. And let the smoke carry your pledge to liberty.

** Uncompromising Quality, Made for Patriots
------------------------------------------------------------

At Patriot Cigar Company, every cigar is handcrafted in Estelí, Nicaragua, using premium-aged tobacco (aged a minimum of three years). Our blends were born from the desire to bring together the love of premium smokes and the love of our country, forging a brand built on passion and pride.

Experience true American freedom with 8 bold, premium cigars—including the gold-wrapped MOGUL and exclusive Operation Never Tell—only available in the Patriot Cigar Company Premium Sampler Pack.

name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is moving
body:
[Unsubscribe](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?xul=zkl8p045sz1uh88qpcsbcn9r1ar6gv1bgdzff3pi88p8luptvhv5swhvu7vlsc7ctrwo9kkt5j6xc1or14b0sxnay75mu198nk8q7annlrop8&__stmp=t4lcqc&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *

| | | | [](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?xtl=1wduekwl7wu19sax5iurxiiyyarfp5tn4euznafhy3pmcebadhy5uleognz9qmvlbb611svnfrikttayzd3wwa4gk81nz9isdx5lqh9fkja4cds0osfzh284z0bsad4erklb2pv72g6aapbv&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lcqc&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏

He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... It's happening. Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. Again, Friend, God is so good. Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, "What can I do?" As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including: ✅ Leadership materials ✅ Pocket Constitutions ✅ Chapter training tools ✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... this won't be a small task. But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. For Charlie. And here's how YOU can help with this... Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter... How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started? Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... This is it**. Also... Here's one more powerful thing you can do: 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... Please send them this link: Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... Thank you. We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come. God is so good. For Charlie, -The Turning Point USA Family P.S. Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, we're grateful. But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter. Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. Peter,

I grew up in Baltimore, and as a lifelong (and long-suffering) Orioles fan, I've always believed in showing up, staying engaged, and keeping faith in the future — values I’m sure many Twins fans can relate to.
My first campaign experience was knocking doors in northern Virginia for Barack Obama in 2008 alongside my dad. That experience lit a spark for me.
I first heard about Keith Ellison back in high school. As a young progressive, I admired his bold voice and his willingness to fight for real change. Our Scorecard is a vital tool to holding our elected officials accountable, but we can’t do it without your help. Will you send your legislators an email today to hold them accountable for how they voted on climate in the 2025 Session? [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2]
Take action [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2?contactdata=xJaARRmme8qW+SLb7SOHOQWbnOclLoe9uwjRx6RFnIaAddkQKTpWwFHg6KH8XIWAgOIQq7wSIhdRKpyZmtsYFnjsN8na3SzKx/QYPeRxqD4l4JGv1p+ftrd6723RF99A]

Dear Peter,
The harsh and devastating reality of Trump 2.0 has cast a dark shadow over Oregon and the nation. As federal protections for clean air, clean water, public lands, and climate are dismantled one by one, the responsibility to defend Oregon’s people and environment now falls squarely on our state’s leaders.
The 2025 session left much work undone. A transportation package that centers climate and equity stalled. Critical water protections were killed behind the scenes. Conservation and wildlife funding was derailed at the last minute. Even with Democratic supermajorities, Oregon was left playing defense while Trump’s administration advanced a full-scale rollback of environmental protections.
We cannot afford to lose another year. That starts with holding our elected leaders accountable. OLCV’s Environmental Scorecard is exactly the tool to do that, and it was just released today! Check to see how your legislators voted by clicking here [https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/] . Now you, Peter, can take action to hold our legislators accountable! [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2]
Take action [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2?contactdata=xJaARRmme8qW+SLb7SOHOQWbnOclLoe9uwjRx6RFnIaAddkQKTpWwFHg6KH8XIWAgOIQq7wSIhdRKpyZmtsYFnjsN8na3SzKx/QYPeRxqD4l4JGv1p+ftrd6723RF99A]
We expect leadership equal to this moment — leadership that refuses to let Washington, D.C. dictate our future. Leadership that acts with urgency, courage, and moral clarity to defend our state’s values, protect our communities, and build the clean, just, and resilient future we all deserve.
Oregon lawmakers fell short on climate action this past session, so this year we decided not to give out legislative awards in the 2025 Scorecard [https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/] , but instead to our volunteers who showed up for our environment. Yet another change we made to the Scorecard [https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/] this year was the introduction of a 5% dedication in any legislator’s score who sponsored a Major Threat. This is a response to the increased number of legislators sponsoring Major Threats during the 2025 session, which is deserving of accountability.
That cannot allow a repeat of the 2025 session. Oregonians deserve leaders who take real action. This is the moment for Oregon to lead.
We are calling on Oregon legislators to:
1. Defend Oregon from federal rollbacks. Take bold, proactive action to shield our state’s air, water, land, and communities from the devastating impacts of Trump’s agenda.
2. Center equity and climate in every major policy package. From transportation to revenue, climate justice must guide your decisions.
3. Fund Oregon’s future. Protect investments in natural resources, community resilience, and clean energy programs that are under attack at the federal level.
4. Deliver the climate progress Oregonians demand. The 2026 short session must not be a pause — it must be a launchpad.
It’s time to let our legislators know we are watching, that the people who breathe this air, drink this water, and call Oregon home are counting on them to rise to the challenge.
Take action [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2?contactdata=xJaARRmme8qW+SLb7SOHOQWbnOclLoe9uwjRx6RFnIaAddkQKTpWwFHg6KH8XIWAgOIQq7wSIhdRKpyZmtsYFnjsN8na3SzKx/QYPeRxqD4l4JGv1p+ftrd6723RF99A]
Even as federal protections crumble, Oregon can be — must be — a beacon. A place where we still believe in science, in stewardship, in justice, and in the power of people to make a difference.
Oregon’s future depends on what our legislators do next. Tell your legislators today that it’s time for them to lead boldly, protect what we love, and defend Oregon! [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2]
Sincerely,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Eliza.png]
Eliza Walton (she/they)

body:
Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-12930515?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
|
---
| Friends and Neighbors,

The last several weeks have been very busy for me and my team. **We closed out September with events throughout the district and then beginning in October we were back in Tallahassee for the start of committee weeks.** As we wrapped up our second committee week last week, I’m excited for all that we will continue to accomplish as we prepare for the upcoming legislative session in January.

**My fellow legislators and I are working tirelessly to put Florida first!** Our state is leading the nation in so many areas, but if we want to keep it that way, we must continue to promote legislation that prioritizes freedom, fiscal responsibility, and our conservative values.**Stay tuned for updates on our progress in the weeks and months to come!**

As always, please do not hesitate to [contact my office](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=1bd8251008&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| | _**Rep. Ryan Chamberlin Files Freedom 1 - A Mandated Property Tax Rollback to the 2022-2023 Levies**_
---
|
---
| Last Friday, October 10, I filed a bill titled: “Freedom 1.”**In short, it is the first of my three-tiered plan to reduce and replace property taxes in the state of Florida with some other form of taxation.** Stay tuned in the weeks and months to come as I continue to fight to eliminate property taxes for good!

**Read the full press release[here](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=83e69fdd0e&e=d1c1b9864f). **
---
| | _**Committee Meetings**_
---
|
---
| **I have the honor of serving on several important committees for the upcoming 2026 Legislative Session.** Since we kicked off committee weeks at the beginning of the month, I have met with the following committees:
* [Intergovernmental Affairs Subcommittee](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=24c8eb0b3f&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [Human Services Subcommittee](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=891ae5c251&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [Justice Budget Subcommittee](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=8b6862cce4&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [Economic Infrastructure Subcommittee](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=fb485ec1cb&e=d1c1b9864f)

Back in September, I also met with the [Select Committee on Property Taxes](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=91e1dd7e64&e=d1c1b9864f) to further our discussion on how to provide meaningful property tax relief for hardworking Florida families.
---
| | _**Speaker Designation Ceremony**_
---
|
---
---
| Congratulations to our newly elected **Speaker-Designate Sam Garrison**! During our first committee week in Tallahassee, we voted in Rep. Garrison to serve as the next **Speaker of the Florida House**. He has been an incredible leader in the State House, and I look forward to serving under his leadership.
---
| While in Tallahassee, I also had the opportunity to attend several other events, including the **Florida Behavioral Health Association Legislative BBQ** , **Charlie Kirk** candlelight vigil, **Florida Section American Water Works Association** reception, and the **Diwali** celebration.
---
| | _**Meetings During Committee Weeks**_
---
|
---
| I was proud to stand in support (and co-sponsor [HB 125](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=7e1b82bd5c&e=d1c1b9864f)) of **Rep. Yvette Benarroch** and **Rep. Meg Weinberger** ’s legislation establishing October 14 as **National Charlie Kirk Day**. This day will honor and celebrate the importance of free speech, civic engagement, and American values.
---
|
---
|
---
| It was great to visit with some students from **Florida State University** who care about the future of our state. Always a pleasure to hear from the next generation about how we can build a better and brighter future for Florida.
---
|
---
|
---
| Thank you to **Director Bob Asztalos with the Agency for Persons with Disabilities** for taking the time to stop by my office to meet with me. We had a great meeting discussing issues facing the agency and the work they’re accomplishing across the state of Florida.
---
|
---
|
---
| I was honored to receive the **2025 Honor Roll Award** from the **Florida Chamber of Commerce** for my work to support Florida’s business community during the legislative session. I’m excited to continue working with them through the upcoming session!
---
|
---
|
---
| I appreciated the opportunity to meet with the **Florida Psychiatric Society** to discuss the state of mental health care in our communities. We are incredibly grateful for their dedication to improving access, treatment, and support for all Floridians.
---
|
---
|
---
| The **Florida Section of the American Water Works Association** ’s leadership plays an integral role in ensuring safe and reliable water for every resident in Florida. I appreciated them taking the time to stop by the Capitol to discuss the importance of protecting and strengthening our state’s water infrastructure.
---
|
---
|
---
| It was great to have a discussion with**Waylon Thompson** from the **Florida Justice Association** about their important work to strengthen and uphold Florida’s civil justice system.
---
|
---
|
---
| While in Tallahassee, I also had the opportunity to meet with **Frank Peterman** from the **Florida Education Association**. Our Florida teachers do incredible work to prepare our students for success, both inside and outside the classroom. We are grateful for their hard work and dedication!
---
| | | _**Events in the District**_
---
|
---
| It was a privilege to take part in the **Kids Central CARE Awards** again this year. The ceremony was a powerful reminder of the dedication of those who serve children and families during their most difficult times. We are grateful for their compassion that continues to strengthen our community.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| **Lt. Governor Jay Collins** hit it out of the park at the **Republican Federated Women of The Villages Annual Fundraiser Dinner**. I’ve enjoyed attending this event over the past several years and supporting such a powerful group working to keep Florida free and strong.
---
|
---
|
---
| **Marion County Fire Rescue** has installed and blessed a new **Safe Haven Baby Box** at **Citra Fire Station #2**. Each box ensures the safe and anonymous surrender of infants, saving lives and giving hope to mothers in crisis.
---
|
---
|
---
| I had the honor of attending **Governor Ron DeSantis** ’s press conference at the **University of Florida**. Florida is ranked #1 in higher education for the 10th consecutive year! We will certainly keep working to improve, but it is obvious that Florida is a leader in many areas of education. Let’s keep it that way!
---
|
---
|
---
| The **Marion County Legislative Delegation** meeting was a great success! Thank you to all the residents who attended and shared your input with us as we prepare for the upcoming legislative session. Your thoughts and insights help make our state even stronger!
---
|
---
| Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

subject: Republicans just got their hand-picked candidate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
This just became one of the toughest and most expensive races in the 2026 election.
Peter, it’s Chris Pappas. I want you to hear it from me first: **John Sununu just entered the race for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.**
That’s right. This just became one of the toughest and most expensive races in the 2026 election. **[So before I go any further, I have to ask: Will you split $10 or more between my campaign and Heartland Patriots today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/96877?refcode=em20251023-9617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9617%2E614464%2EWIFq3i)**
**[Chip in $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/96877?refcode=em20251023-9617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9617%2E614464%2EWIFq3i)**
National Republicans spent months recruiting John Sununu because they know he’s their best shot at flipping this Senate seat.
Sununu first went to Washington over a quarter of a century ago—then he cashed in, making millions while New Hampshire paid the price for his record. Now he’s running to do it again, and this time he’ll have megadonors and special interests powering his campaign.

name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is so good
body:
[unsubscribe](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xul=1nmc5a54x67zfmd5fi2bt1ih19upblguk0x5a1f72g49ihn0mwcbw0vercxoeyd688ty1qdsdcl2vk34dkm4qjmnxozrkx7v9u0q71n3ytzc57al6sp1&__stmp=t4lf7y&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.

Steve Thompson, Editor

* * *

| | | | [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=34017q10ityw3k83p14b0e0zqzcb7cd1b7t0c7pd2fomwk5ya9e9ptjn1qbooi5qwe2xxo4rp70dawur7a7t1xhlu7hrucsb68c48tamla1df64s0c04w9z86283xl33dcourhjz44w0v6hewujdtv&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lf7y&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---

| Dear Fellow American,

**I’m sending you this message because you may not know Judicial Watch works on this issue.
**
Our team just uncovered 2,491 pages of government records indicating doctors at two California medical institutions gave puberty blockers to children as young as 9 years old – **using your tax dollars**.

These records reveal transgender drug and surgical experiments on little children at both University of California, San Francisco and Children’s Hospital Los Angeles _funded by monies from the federal National Institute of Health (NIH_):

* **Doctors pumped children with puberty blockers on your tax dime.**
Self-evidently WRONG!

* **Researchers let grade-schoolers steer their own hormone treatments.** After new transgender “standards of care” were issued, UCSF dropped requirements for mental-health evaluations and moved to a “patient-centered” model that let minors make life-altering decisions.

* **They could not keep their story straight on the children’s ages** First the records said an eight-year-old was experiencing bone weakness from their chemicals...but then they flip-flopped that there was no bone condition—the youngest child given puberty blockers was in fact all of NINE years old—as if that is better!

* **Perpetrators tried to hide their evildoing**.Emails indicate officials scrubbed content on their pediatric activities from web pages to prevent it from being “weaponized,” while coordinating with NIH and conspiring media contacts to manage what the public would see.

_There is something rotten in the state of California. And UCSF and LA Children’s Hospital were trying to cover it up_. But because of Judicial Watch supporters, the truth is finally out in the open.

Thank you for following our work and helping promote it to your friends and family.

**Have you ever considered making a financial contribution to Judicial Watch?

** Besides supporting election integrity, fighting government waste, and exposing selective prosecution of conservative leaders like President Trump, _it would also help us continue uncovering government-funded child abuse_.

Fighting corruption like this is why Judicial Watch exists.

**We can’t stop now** ; every time we uncover one scandal, ten more are hiding behind it.**

**And we cannot wait for Leftists in Congress, the liberal media, or corrupt federal agencies to do their jobs, because they will not.

Financial support is of course necessary to keep us in court forcing truth into the light.

Our model works: _Investigate. Sue. Expose. Repeat_.

Peter,
Since Congress shut down on September 30, federal workers have either been off the job or working without pay. On October 24, they will miss their second paycheck.
Instead of negotiating an end to the shutdown, this administration has threatened mass firings, even pledging to renege on a law President Trump signed to guarantee backpay to workers after a shutdown. No political victory should come through punishing the workers who keep Social Security working, who make sure our water is safe to drink, and who take care of our veterans. As a former federal employee myself, I know that public service is a badge of honor.
The people who are working at Social Security offices, still making sure seniors' checks go out on time, won't get their own check this week. Their bills didn't stop. The rent is still due, and they still have families who need to eat. We need solidarity, not charity.
[Our friends at The Labor Force are distributing grocery cards to federal workers during this shutdown. **Stay In to Stand Up: A cozy fundraiser from the comfort of home**
Do you secretly cheer when plans are cancelled?Do you prefer a quiet reading nook over a crowded room?Good news, this is the event for you!
---
[|

| | **Stay In to Stand Up** is a one-night-only event to support Mike, designed specifically with introverts in mind. This event is for everyone who cares deeply about the cause but prefers to skip the social stuff.
**Mark your calendar** : On Thursday, October 30th, we’re asking our team to do something revolutionary: stay home.
* No dressing up.
* No icebreakers.
* No mingling.
* No Zoom links.

**Here’s how to participate** :
1. **Stay in.** Create your own perfect run of show - tea, comfy socks, your favorite book or that new series you love.
2. **Stand Up.** Make a contribution [here](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=2d65ea178c&e=356c0699dd).
3. **Spread the Cozy.** Forward this invite or share [this link](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=ff0082a77d&e=356c0699dd) with another quiet soul to have their own Stay in to Stand Up evening.

**If sharing on social media in your comfort zone, include step 4:**
1. **Share on socials.** Grab a pic of your cozy setup and tag Mike with #StayInStandUp for @mvsforwi on all social media platforms! (Bonus points if you also share [this link](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=4ebf795e3e&e=356c0699dd))

[Join the movement and donate for this event.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=3018162b83&e=356c0699dd)

# Bessent: "Great years" for 2026 and 2027 as Trump tax policies kick in
U.S. Treasury Secretary **[Scott Bessent predicted Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/c7f85578-6bd3-4a0b-856a-2a3782da6fe1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that consumer prices will begin dropping next month, easing the affordability crisis after halting Biden-era inflation, with energy costs already down and robust 3.8% second-quarter GDP growth fueling recovery.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c7f85578-6bd3-4a0b-856a-2a3782da6fe1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bessent Forecasts Bright Horizon** : Projects 2026 and 2027 as "great years" for American consumers, building on current economic stability and controlled spending.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/2ce61e48-6c8a-4ff0-aebf-f14dfc1ac0cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Tax Cuts Boost Refunds** : Bessent expects substantial first-quarter refunds and real income gains from January 1, as withholding adjusts for no taxes on tips, overtime, or Social Security, plus auto loan deductions.
* **Inflation Gauge Ticks Lower** : Bessent anticipates CPI declining amid lagging housing price adjustments tied to interest rates, **[following steady October consumer sentiment at 55](https://substack.com/redirect/28dda70b-ba94-4c2f-88a3-c9ab5a8fea0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and one-year inflation expectations dipping to 4.6%.
* **Deficit Strategy Targets Growth** : Bessent aims to slash the deficit-to-GDP ratio--the worst since war or recession--by capping spending and targeting at least 5% nominal GDP expansion.
