# **Trump negotiates with US Quantum computing firms about taking a stake after Rare Earth win**
The Trump administration **[is negotiating equity stakes in U.S. quantum computing](https://substack.com/redirect/435ae615-a7fe-43aa-aa01-2b09afd04ede?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** firms like IonQ and Rigetti in exchange for $10 million federal grants, extending government interventions from rare earths and chips to counter China's tech dominance.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/435ae615-a7fe-43aa-aa01-2b09afd04ede?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Quantum Stakes Surge Stocks** : Shares of D-Wave Quantum leaped 16% Thursday, with IonQ up 6% and Rigetti gaining 8%, signaling investor excitement over potential Commerce Department funding and ownership in cutting-edge firms.
* **Rare Earths Echo Precedent** : Defense Department's $400 million investment in MP Materials secured a 15% U.S. stake in July, directly responding to China's export curbs on vital minerals for high-tech supply chains.
* **Semiconductor Ownership Model** : August's 10% government stake in Intel bolstered domestic AI chip production, marking Washington's bold shift to claim equity in strategic tech successes fueled by public dollars.
* **Strategic China Counterplay** : Limited to national security sectors, these moves aim to harness quantum's revolutionary potential in defense and cybersecurity while avoiding overreach, per Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's endorsement.

# AI rides to the rescue of the economy, despite Powell's high rates
Artificial intelligence is **[powering an unexpected U.S. economic surge](https://substack.com/redirect/64c2fb50-2125-45f1-8818-a5975af8943e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , staving off recession despite high interest rates and slowing job growth, as productivity explodes and corporate profits climb, economists say.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/64c2fb50-2125-45f1-8818-a5975af8943e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Productivity Surge Unprecedented** : AI-driven efficiency boosted U.S. worker output by 3.5% annually, the highest in two decades, outpacing pre-pandemic levels.
* **Corporate Profits Soar** : Tech giants like Nvidia and Microsoft report record earnings from AI investments, fueling broader market gains.
* **Labor Market Resilient** : Job additions slowed to 142,000 monthly, yet unemployment holds steady at 4.1%, defying downturn fears.
* **Fed Policy Shift Looms** : The central bank eyes multiple rate cuts in the remainder of 2025 as AI's "soft landing" eases inflation fears without mass layoffs.

# Oil prices up 5% as Trump and the EU crack down on Russian Oil companies
Oil prices rocketed more than 5% to near $66 a barrel Wednesday after the U.S. **[blacklisted Russia's top producers](https://substack.com/redirect/92795dc0-ce35-449d-becd-f1db063b8dd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Rosneft and Lukoil, escalating pressure on Moscow amid attacks on its energy infrastructure and threatening global supplies despite ample stockpiles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/92795dc0-ce35-449d-becd-f1db063b8dd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Sanctions Escalate Geopolitical Pressure** : U.S. has moved to target Russia's largest oil firms in an unprecedented move, joined by EU's full transaction ban on Rosneft and Gazpromneft, heightening risks of production disruptions.
* **India Faces Import Crisis** : India, is a key buyer reliant on Russian crude for over a third of its needs with refinery executives warn deals will become nearly impossible, forcing massive trade rearrangements.
* **China Braces for Shockwaves** : China, a potential absorber of redirected barrels--already importing up to 20% from Russia-- would mean Beijing's oil industry could see volatile shifts if India pulls back sharply.
* **Market Rally Masks Surplus** : This is the biggest jump since June's Israel-Iran flare-up reversing weak forward prices, but the IEA forecasts a supply glut of 4 million barrels daily next year may temper long-term spikes.

# America's Soda just got a whole lot sweeter because of Trump and RFK Jr.
Coca-Cola launches a **[cane sugar-sweetened version](https://substack.com/redirect/322c4921-c6f1-4a5e-ab28-434385d446fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of its iconic soda in select U.S. markets this fall, bowing to President Trump's July demand for an American twist on the beloved Mexican Coke amid health crusades against high-fructose corn syrup.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/322c4921-c6f1-4a5e-ab28-434385d446fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump Sparks Soda Revolution** : President's public July tweet claiming Coca-Cola "agreed" to add real cane sugar ignited the project's acceleration, blending political pressure with viral consumer buzz.
* **Supply Hurdles Delay Nationwide Rollout** : Limited U.S. cane sugar availability and glass bottling constraints force a staggered launch, as CFO John Murphy warns of measured expansion to avoid shortages.
* **Health Hype Meets Expert Skepticism** : RFK Jr.'s MAHA campaign blasts corn syrup as "poison" fueling obesity, but dietitians counter that cane sugar offers no real nutritional edge over its high-fructose rival.
* **Mexican Coke Legacy Inspires Copycat** : Cult-favorite import's "cleaner" taste, proven superior in blind tests, drives demand, prompting chains like Steak 'n Shake to adopt the sweeter formula nationwide.

* * *
* * *
# Lockheed and Northrop shrug off rare earth metal fears in earnings calls
In a escalating US-China trade clash, Beijing's fresh export curbs on rare earth minerals--vital for F-35 jets and Tomahawk missiles--threaten a national security crisis within weeks, experts warn, however Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman **[executives shrugged off the peril during earnings calls](https://substack.com/redirect/589ce260-da45-4b4b-bdcc-52f5fd4a9be5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/589ce260-da45-4b4b-bdcc-52f5fd4a9be5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **China Dominates Rare Earths** : Beijing controls 70% of mining, 90% of processing, and 93% of magnet production, fueling fears of weapon system halts amid tightened defense export bans this month.
* **Contractors Stockpile Supplies** : Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman leaders tout preemptive stockpiling and supply chain audits, boosting confidence in production ramps despite vulnerabilities.
* **Experts Clash on Urgency** : Benchmark's Neha Mukherjee predicts a "days if not weeks" security meltdown, while Morningstar's Nicolas Owens calls the threat overhyped due to years of strategic hoarding.
* **US Builds Domestic Chain** : Recent Pentagon-backed efforts aim to slash reliance on China, aligning with broader strategies to safeguard defense tech amid geopolitical strains.

WaPo - Opinion: A frantic warning from 100 leading experts: Our democracy is in grave danger [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102325_3&amount=25]
We’ll keep this short, Team: those experts are right.
The attacks of the last few years in our state legislatures across the country targeting the right to vote, especially minority communities, are an assault on our democracy.
Now Trump, Musk, DOGE, and the MAGA movement want to privatize our postal service and harm mail-in voting , which has helped millions of Americans vote -- not just in the pandemic, but going back to the states that adopted the widespread practice in the early 90's.
“ Our entire democracy is now at risk ,” they wrote. “ History will judge what we do at this moment. ”
With so much at stake now -- not just with voting rights -- we've got to push our efforts to fight back into overdrive ASAP.

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does. But now, a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry, and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade. It's hear.com's new IX hearing aid. And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations. It’s no wonder hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America. What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special? It’s one of the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing. This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small. The result? An unprecedented amount of power and clarity. This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for unparalleled, crystal clear sound. “It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.” In other words: with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design! Hi Friend,
One of the things that makes Morris County unique is the beauty of our parks, trails, and open spaces. On any given weekend you’ll find families hiking, kids playing soccer, or seniors enjoying a quiet walk - and that quality of life is something worth protecting.
As your Commissioner, I’ve championed preserving open space and expanding recreation. Morris County now has the largest county park system in New Jersey, with over 20,000 acres of land set aside for residents to enjoy.
When you **vote on Tuesday, November 4th** , you’re not just choosing who represents you - you’re choosing whether we continue protecting what makes Morris County special. Without steady leadership, we risk losing the very character that keeps our county such a desirable place to live and raise a family.
I’m committed to making sure our parks and open spaces are there for your children and grandchildren. But I can’t do it alone. Your support through donation and word of mouth helps us share this record with voters across Morris County and ensures we keep the focus on **preserving our quality of life**.
Together, we can keep Morris County green, safe, and thriving.

— Doug

name: Maxine Dexter
subject: Trump’s invasion of our city.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maxine for Congress
body:
https://maxinefororegon.com/ [https://maxinefororegon.com/]
Peter, it's Maxine.
Portland is a city full of families who take care of each other, no matter what authoritarian lies Trump uses to justify his invasion.
On Monday, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit handed down an indefensible ruling allowing the Trump administration to proceed with a National Guard deployment to Portland— for now.
For weeks, the Trump administration has been trying to incite violence from protestors in front of the ICE detention facility. Instead, they’ve gotten Portland at its best: inflatable costumes, naked bike rides, and a community banding together with compassion and peace.
Deploying the National Guard is just another attempt to paint Portland as a “war-ravaged” city.
But no matter what lies Trump tells reporters—or what fake pictures he tries to pass off as Portland—we know the truth.
We’re not going to bend the knee: I’m working with Oregon leaders in the courts and in Congress to stop this National Guard deployment. But every voice makes a difference. That’s why I need you.
Sign my petition and stand with me against Trump’s abuse of power. Tell me what you’re seeing on our streets. I’m listening, and I’m fighting back with you. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/7SoRWiWUvUanUME5g288Hw2]
SIGN MY PETITION: No Troops in Portland [https://secure.ngpvan.com/7SoRWiWUvUanUME5g288Hw2]
Please stay peaceful and record your interactions. Trump wants to provoke us as an excuse to take harsher action.
Maxine
https://secure.ngpvan.com/7SoRWiWUvUanUME5g288Hw2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/7SoRWiWUvUanUME5g288Hw2] Maxine Dexter is a critical care physician with decades of experience using facts and following science to help her patients.
Now she's using those skills in Congress to ensure healthy communities by standing up to Big Pharma, fighting climate change, and expanding reproductive rights, as well as rebuilding a fair economy for all by protecting Social Security and Medicare.
To learn more about Maxine, visit MaxineForOregon.com [https://maxinefororegon.com/] .

| | Peter ,

I have big news to share. **Congressman Matt Gaetz, Congresswoman Lauren Boebert, and Nevada Republican Party Chairman Michael McDonald** will join me at my official campaign launch event on[ ](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=1ba76bed60&e=273c9a71fb)[Saturday, October 25th, at Fervent Cavalry Chapel ](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=3329a93732&e=273c9a71fb)in Las Vegas.

For too long, Horsford has voted with radical Democrats and the Washington insiders, pushing policies that have hurt Nevada families and weakened our nation. It’s time for that to change.

We’re facing an uphill battle, and I need folks like you by my side to make it to the top.
#

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Sherrod Brown is running for Senate in Ohio, and we’re working to support him. I hope you’ll read the message below from him, and [**consider splitting a donation between Sherrod's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sherrod-brown.a43gKG&refcode=em251023-1-90&t=1&akid=6224%2E6688874%2ExLa45D)

I know you’re likely getting a ton of emails from candidates and causes right now.
**But I have to ask:[Is there anything I can say to convince you to chip in $3 between Mark Kelly and my Senate campaign in Ohio?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sherrod-brown.a43gKG&refcode=em251023-1-90&t=2&akid=6224%2E6688874%2ExLa45D)

What if I told you that misleading attack ads have already hit the airwaves – and that whether we’re able to counter these smears and reach voters with the truth depends on people like you?
**This grassroots, small-dollar donor movement is our best chance to flip Ohio’s Senate seat. But we’re facing an uphill battle, and I need folks like you by my side to win.**
[**So please, split $3 or more between Mark Kelly and me to power our campaign forward, win in Ohio, and keep up the fight for working people.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sherrod-brown.a43gKG&refcode=em251023-1-90&t=3&akid=6224%2E6688874%2ExLa45D)

subject: This is why the government is still shut down
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
Last week, I reached out to ask how rising healthcare costs are affecting you and your family. The response was overwhelming.
Here are a few stories that I heard:
“I have to spend every penny I have to purchase my medicine. I have no money left even to put gas in my car.”

| | Hi friends,
🚨 **ICYMI, Day 5** of the **Douglas County Dirty Dozen** is out now... The Community Choice Slate — four union-backed radicals endorsed by Planned Parenthood and the Socialist Working Families Party — want control of Douglas County classrooms. Voters will decide if their agenda belongs in our schools. Watch the latest video and follow along on [X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Instagram](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Facebook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) & [TikTok](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)!
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A new Common Sense Institute report found that while recidivism has dropped, [violent crime is climbing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—driven by bail reforms, reduced arrests, and shifting sentencing priorities. Meanwhile, an audit revealed 16 mostly rural [school districts face financial distress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Denver joined a lawsuit against the Trump administration over [alleged illegal conditions on federal grants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and Douglas County [school board races are heating up](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) around safety, gender policies, and union power—mirroring broader ideological divides across the state.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** The Supreme Court will review [whether banning gun ownership for drug users](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) violates the Second Amendment—a case that could reshape firearm law. Meanwhile, [Wikipedia co-founder Larry Sanger](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is calling for a “radical overhaul,” warning the platform has lost its neutrality and become an echo chamber for propaganda.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** Climate activists are [taking their agenda to court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after legislative defeats, with a Montana judge tossing a youth-led climate case while Colorado’s Supreme Court allowed Boulder County’s suit against ExxonMobil and Suncor to move forward. Cory Gaines warns that legislative immunity shouldn’t shield [lawmakers who silence public testimony](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), arguing that unchecked power erodes trust in government. Mike O’Donnell links [Colorado’s auto theft crisis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to years of lenient sentencing—with 2 out of 3 vehicles recovered in 2024. Meanwhile, Shaina Cole [highlights Aurora’s Danielle Jurinsky](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for delivering real results in public safety.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, October 23, 2025.

Peter,

You see, my father's story isn't just about him - it's about the opportunities that America provides. It's about the chance to build a better life, to work hard, and to succeed. And that's exactly what I'm fighting for.

In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. I ran to effect real change and instill common-sense conservative leadership. That's exactly what we have done and will continue to do.

This is my story. In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. I ran to effect real change and instill common-sense conservative leadership. That's exactly what we have done and will continue to do. Before becoming the 2nd in command in Virginia, I beat a 20-year incumbent in 2001 to become the first Republican to win a seat in a majority black district in the Virginia House of Delegates since 1865. Of course, none of this would have been possible without my husband, Terence, and my amazing daughters. Throughout all of this, they have been my rock, and I owe them everything - they have kept me grounded, confident, and optimistic for the future. As you can see, I've lived a full life. There have been highs, lows, and everything in between, but I don't regret a single thing. I maintain, without a shadow of a doubt, that my story is only possible in America. clean_body: I’ve never backed down from doing what’s right — even when it wasn’t popular — and I won’t start now. | Fellow patriot — You may already know me – some of you know me and my story well. But I want to take this opportunity to reintroduce myself and share some exciting news. My name is Mark Lamb — I’m a husband, father, God-fearing American, and the proud former Sheriff of Pinal County, Arizona. After much prayer and reflection with my family, I’ve made a huge decision: I am officially running for Congress in Arizona’s 5th District! This isn’t about ambition — it’s about service. I’ve seen what happens when leaders lack courage and conviction, and I refuse to sit by while feckless politicians and bureaucrats fail our nation’s families. I’ve never backed down from doing what’s right — even when it wasn’t popular — and I won’t start now. Before I go any further, I want to thank Congressman Andy Biggs for his years of service to AZ-5 and wish him well in his decision to step down from this seat and run for Governor of Arizona. Andy has always fought hard for conservative values, and you can trust that I will do the same. You know me, and you know my record. As Sheriff, I spent years on the frontlines — battling the fentanyl epidemic, fighting cartel violence spilling over our borders, rescuing children from trafficking rings, and holding gang members and criminals accountable. Every day, I put on my badge and carried the responsibility of keeping our communities safe. I’ve seen families ripped apart by crime and drugs, and I’ve felt that pain personally. I’ve seen firsthand the devastating effects of rising crime and failing leadership. I won’t stand by while career politicians in Washington make excuses, play politics, and leave families unprotected. Our liberty, our safety, and our freedom are not guaranteed by silence — they are defended through action. I will fight in Congress for the same principles I’ve lived by as Sheriff: personal responsibility, faith, courage, and an unwavering commitment to the people I serve. I will stand up to the woke left, to the weak political establishment, and to anyone who puts politics above the safety of our communities. This fight will not be easy. Washington isn’t used to someone who tells it like it is, someone who’s willing to get their hands dirty and put people over politics. But that’s exactly what I intend to do — for Arizona families, for our law enforcement, and for our Constitution. I’m ready to step up and bring real leadership to Congress, but I can’t do it alone. Every contribution — big or small — sends a message: that hard-working families won’t be ignored, that our freedoms matter, and that courage still counts in America. I’m ready, fellow patriot. Are you with me? For God, Family, and Country, Mark Lamb Republican for Congress, AZ-5 P.S. I want to make it clear that the outpouring of support you’ve shown me and my wife, Janel, in the past factored into our decision to make this run. As Sheriff, I couldn’t have accomplished what I did without my deputies, and I won’t be able to succeed in this fight without you. Thank you! **Jones is actively under criminal investigation by a special prosecutor **— and he's running to be Virginia's top law enforcement officer. This has **never** happened in Virginia's history.

Think about that for a moment. **The man who wants the power to prosecute your family and our police is currently being investigated himself.**

---
A special prosecutor doesn't get appointed for routine cases, friend. **This means there are serious issues involved, and the investigation is "currently pending."**

**You cannot be Virginia’s Attorney General while being investigated by Virginia’s criminal prosecutors. This is insanity.**
---

Jay Jones should suspend his campaign and withdraw from the race for Attorney General.

Peter,

It’s been a very long time since Republicans won a full six-year Senate term in Minnesota.

The year was 2002, and **the first season of American Idol had just premiered; Kelly Clarkson wasn’t yet a household name in the United States.**

**CSI was the top show on network TV,** dethroning ER from its long-held spot atop the charts, and Everybody Loves Raymond was still airing weekly.

_**DVDs were just beginning to overtake VHS systems in our homes, and Netflix was still in its infancy as a DVD-by-mail rental service. It would be another four years, 2007, before Netflix launched its streaming service.**_

**23 YEARS IS LONG ENOUGH. BUT DEMOCRATS THINK MINNESOTA IS THEIR TERRITORY, NEVER TO BE CEDED TO A REPUBLICAN - EVER.**

**It’s time to send them a message: Time’s up.**

clean_body: It’s been a very long time since Republicans won a full six-year Senate term in Minnesota | Peter, It’s been a very long time since Republicans won a full six-year Senate term in Minnesota. The year was 2002, and the first season of American Idol had just premiered; Kelly Clarkson wasn’t yet a household name in the United States. CSI was the top show on network TV, dethroning ER from its long-held spot atop the charts, and Everybody Loves Raymond was still airing weekly. DVDs were just beginning to overtake VHS systems in our homes, and Netflix was still in its infancy as a DVD-by-mail rental service. It would be another four years, 2007, before Netflix launched its streaming service. 23 YEARS IS LONG ENOUGH. BUT DEMOCRATS THINK MINNESOTA IS THEIR TERRITORY, NEVER TO BE CEDED TO A REPUBLICAN - EVER. It’s time to send them a message: Time’s up. A poll released recently by one of my opponent’s campaigns has breathed new life into this race - according to their pollster, a generic Republican candidate only trails the Democrats by TWO POINTS. Over the last several months, I’ve been making a concerted effort to introduce myself to you via email and text messages. Have you received and read them? If not, let me quickly reintroduce myself to you today. I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks, enlisted after 9/11, and served in over 70 countries, leading high-stakes missions with discipline and resolve. Service is my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. I’m running for U.S. Senate to fight for the America we love, the one you’ve worked hard to build for your children and grandchildren. If I can prove to the national Republican party apparatus that I’m a contender who can raise funds independently, they’ll take me seriously and provide the firepower we need to win this race. I need help raising $100,000 by the end of this month, and so far, we’re halfway there. So, The founding fathers didn’t intend for this to be a one-party democracy. There hasn’t been much competition in Minnesota politics lately. subject: Reproductive care is at risk
body:
| | Peter – It’s no secret that reproductive care and abortion access are under grave threat from ultra-conservative extremists across the country.

Now, a few months after Planned Parenthood lost federal Medicaid funding thanks to the GOP’s July budget bill, many clinics have been shuttered, and the remaining ones are struggling to survive.

Washington State has stepped up to cover the funding gap and fight back in the courts, but we can’t stop there. If these federal attacks continue, millions of women nationwide stand to lose access to affordable preventive care, cancer screenings, contraception, and other critical health services.

Lives are at risk, Peter. That’s no exaggeration. _Especially_ in rural communities like ours, where the nearest women’s health clinic may be hours away.

Our fight is far from over. I won’t give up until all women have access to safe reproductive and maternal care.

[We urgently need a pro-choice majority in the House to codify a woman’s right to control her own body. Our right to protest isn’t just guaranteed by the First Amendment, Peter. It’s woven through the history of our country.
From the Boston Tea Party to MLK’s March on Washington, Americans have a long-standing tradition of uniting by the millions and demonstrating for our freedoms.
**_And that makes authoritarians like Trump furious._**
Over seven million Americans took to the streets in peaceful protest recently, across nearly 3,000 events. Their position was clear: **Democracy over dictatorship.** For many, it was a day of hope, community, and connection, as well as a chance to make a visible commitment to defending the freedoms and rights we all hold dear.
But Republicans, especially Trump’s minions, couldn’t stop whining about it. Speaker of the House Mike Johnson called it a “hate America rally.” When asked for comment on the rallies, White House spokeswoman Abigail Jackson blew off the question: "Who cares?"
**Here’s the truth: Over _seven million people_ care — including us, Peter.** If you’re like us, you’re sick of the authoritarian bullying, threats, and intimidation. We won’t stand for Trump’s attacks on our First Amendment freedoms, including our liberty to speak, protest, and freely associate. _Because the truth is that protest is patriotic._

clean_body: Where do you stand re: our right to protest? | | YOUR OPINION NEEDED Peter: Is our right to protest worth protecting? | | ---|--- Our right to protest isn’t just guaranteed by the First Amendment, Peter. It’s woven through the history of our country. From the Boston Tea Party to MLK’s March on Washington, Americans have a long-standing tradition of uniting by the millions and demonstrating for our freedoms. And that makes authoritarians like Trump furious. Over seven million Americans took to the streets in peaceful protest recently, across nearly 3,000 events. Their position was clear: Democracy over dictatorship. For many, it was a day of hope, community, and connection, as well as a chance to make a visible commitment to defending the freedoms and rights we all hold dear. But Republicans, especially Trump’s minions, couldn’t stop whining about it. Speaker of the House Mike Johnson called it a “hate America rally.” When asked for comment on the rallies, White House spokeswoman Abigail Jackson blew off the question: "Who cares?" Here’s the truth: Over seven million people care — including us, Peter. If you’re like us, you’re sick of the authoritarian bullying, threats, and intimidation. We won’t stand for Trump’s attacks on our First Amendment freedoms, including our liberty to speak, protest, and freely associate. Because the truth is that protest is patriotic. So we’re asking for your opinion on this: Is our right to protest worth protecting? | ---|--- Onward, Unite the Country | Unite the Country is dedicated to electing Democrats who support common sense policies, champion middle class values and are willing to engage Americans regardless of where they live — but we can’t do it without you! subject: Our state faces a childcare crisis
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Phil Weiser for Colorado
body:
We need a childcare system that is accessible and affordable.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117863024/577888033/1239926708?refcode=em_WEI_FR_Childcare_102325&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzM5YzU4ZC00YmIwLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BH41Y8CBDlCuJ542ZTAcI3pEcza9pOZihTfRoJw1GRY=&emci=6d1fd18f-2cb0-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=1c39c58d-4bb0-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520) Could you part ways with almost 40% of your annual pay to cover childcare, friend? That’s the stunning reality for too many Colorado parents today — even where assistance is available, it’s too tough to access, and the costs are out of reach. As of this month, nearly 7,500 working families were stuck on a childcare waitlist, or their access to care was affected because of funding freezes. And over half of Coloradans live in a childcare desert, meaning parents have little or no options except to leave the workforce when they have kids. **Putting it simply: Our state is facing a childcare crisis.** **[As governor, I’ll tackle our need for affordable, quality childcare and hit the ground running on this issue. If you agree that Colorado needs a governor who’s ready to get to work on this urgent issue, will you make your first $5 contribution to our campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117863025/577888034/-1377276739?refcode=em_WEI_FR_Childcare_102325&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzM5YzU4ZC00YmIwLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BH41Y8CBDlCuJ542ZTAcI3pEcza9pOZihTfRoJw1GRY=)** | | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117863026/577888035/-1377276739?refcode=em_WEI_FR_Childcare_102325&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzM5YzU4ZC00YmIwLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BH41Y8CBDlCuJ542ZTAcI3pEcza9pOZihTfRoJw1GRY=)

This crisis is complicated. And that means one-size-fits-all solutions won’t cut it. These are just a few of the many childcare initiatives from my plan that I’ll champion as our state’s next governor:
✅**Protecting funding for successful early childhood programs** , especially as we face state budget challenges and cuts to federal healthcare dollars.
✅**Unifying childcare services as a user-friendly statewide system** because we know navigating the many provider types, programs, and funding streams is too cumbersome for providers and parents.
✅**Signing an executive order on day one** to get to work on evaluating what’s broken and begin developing solutions so we can get to work fixing those problems immediately.
✅**Working with voters** to show how our state budget constraints throttle our ability to make the high-value investments our kids deserve, and creating flexibility to make those investments.
✅**Forging plans for long-term, sustainable funding** by partnering with the general assembly to meet our urgent childcare needs by adopting models we already know work well, like Colorado’s own Employer-Based Child Care Design Lab and Iowa’s Childcare Solutions Fund.
✅**Streamlining rules and red tape** through listening and hand-in-hand work with parents, providers, local leaders, and community partners. Because we don’t need to choose between keeping kids safe and helping more childcare providers open their doors — _we can have both._
We’ve got a lot of work ahead, and it will take many partners to create the kind of change we need. And it’s work I’m ready to take on as governor — because I’m committed to listening and delivering for every child in our state.

Phil

clean_body: We need a childcare system that is accessible and affordable. Could you part ways with almost 40% of your annual pay to cover childcare, friend? That’s the stunning reality for too many Colorado parents today — even where assistance is available, it’s too tough to access, and the costs are out of reach. As of this month, nearly 7,500 working families were stuck on a childcare waitlist, or their access to care was affected because of funding freezes. And over half of Coloradans live in a childcare desert, meaning parents have little or no options except to leave the workforce when they have kids. Putting it simply: Our state is facing a childcare crisis. = | | = This crisis is complicated. And that means one-size-fits-all solutions won’t cut it. These are just a few of the many childcare initiatives from my plan that I’ll champion as our state’s next governor: ✅Protecting funding for successful early childhood programs , especially as we face state budget challenges and cuts to federal healthcare dollars. ✅Unifying childcare services as a user-friendly statewide system because we know navigating the many provider types, programs, and funding streams is too cumbersome for providers and parents. ✅Signing an executive order on day one to get to work on evaluating what’s broken and begin developing solutions so we can get to work fixing those problems immediately. ✅Working with voters to show how our state budget constraints throttle our ability to make the high-value investments our kids deserve, and creating flexibility to make those investments. ✅Forging plans for long-term, sustainable funding by partnering with the general assembly to meet our urgent childcare needs by adopting models we already know work well, like Colorado’s own Employer-Based Child Care Design Lab and Iowa’s Childcare Solutions Fund. ✅Streamlining rules and red tape through listening and hand-in-hand work with parents, providers, local leaders, and community partners. Because we don’t need to choose between keeping kids safe and helping more childcare providers open their doors — we can have both. We’ve got a lot of work ahead, and it will take many partners to create the kind of change we need. And it’s work I’m ready to take on as governor — because I’m committed to listening and delivering for every child in our state. = With you for our kids, Phil | Make sure this email goes to your inbox. Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lpga&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lpga&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?

---

---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lpga&__onlt=h)

Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?xtl=u3vjmpooycjyw0xephc6ymtnuw95v83910ww5ylh6z2tk0xsel0dr13qwqzwxu5luulzgsr45813n27sq976nhbr04zzrlw4re30jazb5yx9q5mw9to0bd1vwoh95mmw8nwto7z6mgxk&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lpga&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.

clean_body: Your trust in me means the world. | Peter — I know that millions of people who are absolutely disgusted with Donald Trump’s presidency are looking to next month’s election to provide some hope. I know that whether we win or lose — and believe me, it’s looking close — will set the tone for what comes next in 2026, 2028, and beyond. I know that if we lose, Trump will just be emboldened to attack our institutions and our communities even more aggressively. But I also know that if we win, we can start to turn the tide in a better direction. And that we will send a powerful message — to Donald Trump and to the entire country — that the American people do not accept the past nine months of cruelty and authoritarianism as our new normal. Peter, my first and last thought every single day is how much is riding on our success in this election. But together, I know we can get this done. name: Team Kaptur
subject: What scares us most about the GOP budget
body:
Republicans' budget proposal is horrifying, friend — and not in a fun Halloween way.

| |
---
Friend, Republicans have shut down the government for nearly three weeks in an attempt to get a disastrous budget bill passed — and what's in the bill is terrifying. **We should call this what it is: the GOP's latest attempt to eviscerate affordable health care for millions of Americans.** Republicans already cut Medicaid by $1 trillion this summer. They slashed $536 billion from Medicare, even after promising not to touch the program that millions of seniors rely on. _Now, Republicans are once again trying to gut the Affordable Care Act, sending premiums skyrocketing for more than 20 million people._ Friend, families across the country are already facing a cost-of-living crisis thanks to Donald Trump's reckless trade wars. Working people can't afford to see their healthcare costs double or even triple. **[Marcy and her Democratic colleagues are doing everything in their power to avert this catastrophe. clean_body: He's not running to serve Virginia's communities — he's running to serve Donald Trump. | = Peter, we need to be blunt with you: John Reid is one of the most dangerous, extreme candidates we've seen. And he's running for lieutenant governor of Virginia. Reid isn't just another Republican. He's a shock jock-style talk radio host turned MAGA politician who's spent years spreading lies, defending the indefensible, and pushing Donald Trump's agenda at every turn. = | = John Reid defended the Jan. 6 rioters. He spread election lies. He even bragged on air about punching people. It got so bad that Republican Gov. Youngkin called for him to drop out of the race. He compared abortion to slavery and made disturbing comments suggesting women seeking care just want to "kill their baby." He wants to ban abortion in Virginia and defund Planned Parenthood. He said "it may be time to just close the public schools" — the schools that over one million Virginia kids depend on — so he can divert Virginians' tax dollars to expensive private schools instead. He supported slashing health care for more than 300,000 Virginians — children, veterans, seniors in nursing homes, and hard-working families already stretched thin. And he's Trump's "yes man" through and through. Reid backed the "DOGE" cuts that will eliminate 32,000 Virginia jobs this year alone. He supports Trump's job-killing tariffs that are raising prices across the board. But standing in his way is Ghazala Hashmi — a proven leader, educator, and champion for Virginia families who will fight for affordable health care, fully funded public schools, and an economy that works for everyone, not just billionaires. This race is close, and Reid has the full weight of the MAGA machine behind him. The energy was joyous. The message was clear: our democracy belongs to the people, not to would-be dictators.
But rallies, as powerful as they are, only take us halfway. The real test is what we do with that energy next.
What if we told you there was a way to turn the momentum of No Kings into a direct, tangible victory against MAGA extremism?
Because in less than two weeks, three Democratic justices on the Pennsylvania Supreme Court face retention. And MAGA operatives are quietly plotting to remove them. If they succeed, they'll take control of Pennsylvania's highest court, gerrymander every blue seat they can, impose an extreme abortion ban, and rig the rules of the 2026 midterms and 2028 presidential election.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: What I told the crowd at No Kings in Seattle
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20251023-5556-footer&t=1001&akid=5556%2E420207%2EUG1xhr ]Pramila Jayapal

Peter,

Last weekend, more than seven million people turned out at 2,300 events
nationwide to declare that we will bow to No King in America. I had a
chance to address the crowd in Seattle, and I’ve included the text of that
speech below.

I hope you’ll give it a read. We’re at an inflection point in the history
of our country, and each of us has a duty to stand up and do what we can
to defend the ideals that our nation was built on.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20251023.CRcgW2&refcode=em20251023-5556&t=1002&akid=5556%2E420207%2EUG1xhr ]When you’re done reading, I hope you’ll pitch in to support the work
I’m doing for our movement. I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs or
lobbyists — I’m counting on the people to keep my campaign going.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Millions turned out this weekend because we’re up against a serious choice
in our country.

At the 1787 Constitutional Convention, Benjamin Franklin was asked what
kind of a government they had created. And he famously responded, “A
Republic... if you can keep it.” We are at the moment that will determine if
we can keep it.

It would be easy to look at what is happening around us and throw up our
hands, be angry, be frustrated, blame someone else, or just disengage
because there’s too much hate, corruption, cruelty and violence — led from
the top by a man who is clearly not well.

A wannabe king who dehumanizes trans people, immigrants and Black people
to distract you from his real agenda.

A wannabe king who sends National Guard troops and masked men into our
cities, militarizing our streets, kidnapping and disappearing tens of
thousands of people from our communities, and trying to suppress dissent
and peaceful protest.

A wannabe king who has politicized the entire Justice Department and uses
the federal government to go after his political opponents on a revenge
tour, all while he accepts luxury jets from foreign countries and makes
billions on his own meme coins.

A wannabe king who has willfully destroyed trust in government with his
lies, humiliating and threatening civil servants, shuttering federal
agencies, firing 200,000 federal workers, and shutting down the
government, furloughing another 750,000 federal workers and illegally
threatening not to pay them.

None of these things are disconnected. As written in Project 2025 and
enacted with frightening speed, this is the destruction of our Republic,
designed to take over control of our government so it answers only to the
King, not us — to divide us so he can take our power and turn it into his
power and reward the billionaires, giant corporations and anyone else who
bends the knee with trillions of dollars of tax breaks, and pardons to
violent insurrectionists, sex predators and corporate thieves.

Franklin knew these moments would come. That this republic was a massive
experiment and whatever wisdom they had 300 years ago would need updating
for the moment, and protection from the constant threat of wannabe kings.
He knew that it would be We the People who would decide in every single
moment what kind of nation we are and what kind of nation we will be
tomorrow.

And in the violence of this moment, we are called to bring love. In the
cowardice of the bully, we are called to bring the strength of the people.
In the shadow of fear, we are called to bring compassion and support to
those most vulnerable. In the horror of dehumanization, we are called to
make real our own humanity and refuse to turn against each other.

In the depths of the lies, we are called to shout from the rooftops these
self-evident truths:

* That all people are created equal and endowed with certain unalienable
rights;
* That among these are life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness;
* That governments derive their powers from the consent of the governed;
* And that whenever any form of government becomes destructive of these
ends, it is the Right of the People to alter or abolish it and
institute new government to effect the safety and happiness of the
people.

That is directly from the Declaration of Independence. And it’s not just
our right, but our obligation to one another.

We are at that moment again when it is up to us to secure the safety and
happiness of the people and to demand a government that works for us, not
for a King, not for the billionaires but for working people and poor
people—whatever race, gender or zip code you live in.

A country where people are not saddled with debt, worry and sleepless
nights, but instead can actually afford housing, childcare, education,
universal healthcare and a solid retirement so they thrive not just
survive.

Where the 99% have the majority of wealth and income instead of the 1% of
billionaires. Where we work for true peace around the world, not war.
Where we lift each other up instead of turning on one another. Where we
glory the selfless, not the selfish. Where there is due process, free
speech, and the freedom to protest and assemble.

Millions turned out today because we know this is that moment. Protests
are powerful, they keep us united, they speak our deepest truths out loud,
and they draw us in.

But the work is every day to topple the pillars of power that prop up
wannabe Kings and move toward nonviolent non-cooperation, a powerful force
that has been used time and time again to bring down dictators and
authoritarians.

WE have to let those who cave or those who remain silent when they should
speak up — the universities, law firms, corporations — know that we are
watching you, we will push back, and we WILL call you out.

We have so many great examples of this already. The Tesla takedowns worked
and got Elon Musk out of DOGE. Rapid response networks are videoing the
violence of ICE agents so they can’t hide. Communities are forming
nonviolent barriers to protect their neighbors and friends. Schools and
apartment complexes and cities and states are refusing to allow for
illegal action. That is what nonviolent non-cooperation looks like.

Because here’s the thing: repressive regimes overestimate their power and
underestimate the power of the people. They miscalculate that we will cave
instead of standing up.

And this weekend, on the 18th day of the Republican shutdown, they
miscalculated. We are NOT caving in.

As they illegally try to send National Guard troops and ICE agents into
our cities to militarize our streets, show them that they once again
miscalculated in thinking that all Americans hate immigrants and would get
behind mass deportations or allowing the military in our streets.

From Joe Rogan speaking out against those mass deportations, to the 12
million Americans who live in a household with an undocumented immigrant,
to our American economy that would never survive without the contributions
of immigrants of all statuses, they miscalculated.

We are a country uniquely tied to our immigrant identity, and if you want
to come for immigrants, you have to go through ALL of us.

They miscalculated because they forgot the simple truth: that power
doesn’t flow from the top down, it flows from the bottom up.

So now is the moment to make their miscalculations backfire on them, to
build our bottom up power and grow our nonviolent resistance movement.

That’s exactly why I’ve launched my Resistance Lab trainings, based on
real research about how to effectively and non-violently fight
authoritarians and dictators — not just on our days of coordinated action
and protest, but every single day in between.

Thousands and thousands of We the People from all 50 states and over half
a dozen countries have already participated to understand the frameworks
of how democracies crumble, and to leave with real tools, knowledge, and
actions you can take to protect our democracy.

If there’s one thing you do today, go to ResistanceLab.US and sign up for
a virtual Resistance Lab training.

There are tens of thousands of people here—and MILLIONS across the
country. Imagine what would happen if each person that attended a No Kings
event today went home and engaged in one act of nonviolent resistance, in
whatever way they can. Imagine how those individual seeds of resistance
would BRAID together into something bigger, stronger, and more rooted.
Imagine the small acts of courage that ripple out, inspire others, and
shift the tide even more quickly.

So, right now, let’s show the power of our movement. I want you to let us
ALL hear what OUR power sounds like.

No Kings!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

subject: God is moving
body:
[unsubscribe](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xul=o5pvyewrzrxe8xiau9slbgewytpzg8uokga3wng5alx9u4ostxu6sc84h5n82jwxrabflrgkgydb6oszwno27cq45r00s8zsslmrq57&__stmp=t4lrav&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)

Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *
| | | | [](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=edb8w7bac24wgmnakjc2b5en5be9rz85hyug0ufe5unc9dod2n0el6qhm2uge7yp83204rscznjufzdg05ll68qpg6hshx9ablwm5yyhi8z027iogywlytkf9zbzxhzkzjnghinjx&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lrav&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---

Phoenix, Arizona 85044

The president is not a king, and the White House is not his personal palace.

---
Friend – this is absolutely egregious.
Time and time again, we've seen President Trump prioritize his personal interests over acting in the best interests of the American people.
He accepted a plane – that is so lavish it is called a "palace in the sky" – from an autocratic foreign government that will cost billions in taxpayer money to retrofit to security standards.

He sicced the FCC on television broadcast networks to silence his critics.

He demanded a $230 million taxpayer-funded payout from his own DOJ for investigating him, even as he weaponizes the same department to prosecute his perceived political enemies.
So now, as:
* Troops and federal workers go unpaid,
* Food banks run dry,
* Soybean farmers risk insolvency, and
* 24 million Americans come face-to-face with sky-high health care premiums

– can you guess what's at the top of his to-do list?
_Tearing down the East Wing of the White House to build a $250 million golden ballroom in its place._
**The president is not a king, and the White House is not his personal palace. **It's the People's House – not a Trump Tower.
While Trump continues to consider only himself, Colorado’s working families can’t afford to wait on Washington to solve our problems.
**They have to start here with us in Colorado.** So I promise that as governor, ensuring the well-being of every person who calls our state home will be my _only_ priority.
**But since I'm not a wannabe king like Trump, I can't do it without your help to reach my****$30,000****end-of-month goal by midnight on Halloween.**

Peter,

_Comey, the _REAL_ criminal, and then yours truly, facing down the rest of my life in prison as an INNOCENT man. _

---
Look, as the lawyer who successfully defended President Trump from the Democrats’ witch hunts, I felt reassured in knowing I could **_at least defend myself_** from the Left’s bogus charges...
---
_...Or so I thought!_
---
_**The Democrats’ cronies even STRIPPED me of my law licenses!**_
---
**Left with no means to defend myself, no way to be pardoned, no cavalry coming over the hill, and no lifeline, my _ONLY_ chance was to secure a top-notch defense team.**
---
But the reality is, the Left had already forced me to the point of **BANKRUPTCY**.
---
_They knew full well this was exactly the kind of defense I couldn’t afford!_
---
Peter, just months out from the **TRIAL OF MY LIFE** , the situation I now find myself in is simple, but sadly, bleak.
---
My last remaining hope of assembling the quality of defense required to BEAT the Left’s sham charges and WIN the trial of my life is patriots like _YOU_.
---

clean_body: This is unprecedented in Virginia politics.| | | Patriot, Jay Jones is making history, but for all the wrong reasons. Jones is actively under criminal investigation by a special prosecutor — and he's running to be Virginia's top law enforcement officer. This has never happened in Virginia's history. Think about that for a moment. The man who wants the power to prosecute your family and our police is currently being investigated himself. A special prosecutor doesn't get appointed for routine cases, friend. This means there are serious issues involved, and the investigation is "currently pending." You cannot be Virginia’s Attorney General while being investigated by Virginia’s criminal prosecutors. This is insanity. As a prosecutor who's spent years working with other prosecutors across Virginia, I can tell you this is unprecedented. No credible law enforcement professional would hire someone under active criminal investigation — let alone make them their boss. Jones wants to lead the very system that's currently investigating him for criminal conduct. That's not just wrong — it's the recipe for a constitutional crisis in Virginia. Jay Jones should suspend his campaign and withdraw from the race for Attorney General. ⚠️ — Attorney General Jason Miyares | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | | Paid for by Miyares for Virginia | | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | | |

| | | **Working families are on the edge of a healthcare disaster, Peter.** Premiums are set to soar when open enrollment begins November 11— and millions of families could face skyrocketing costs if Republicans continue refusing to extend healthcare tax credits. This isn’t a future problem — it’s happening now, and every day that Republicans refuse to negotiate a healthcare deal puts families at risk. Trump and Congressional Republicans are _choosing_ to shut down the government rather than pass a funding bill that protects healthcare for working families. They don’t care that premiums are spiraling, prescriptions are unaffordable, or that lives are on the line. clean_body: | | | Working families are on the edge of a healthcare disaster, Peter. Premiums are set to soar when open enrollment begins November 11— and millions of families could face skyrocketing costs if Republicans continue refusing to extend healthcare tax credits. This isn’t a future problem — it’s happening now, and every day that Republicans refuse to negotiate a healthcare deal puts families at risk. Trump and Congressional Republicans are choosing to shut down the government rather than pass a funding bill that protects healthcare for working families. They don’t care that premiums are spiraling, prescriptions are unaffordable, or that lives are on the line. Their only priority is keeping billionaire donors happy. If healthcare tax credits aren’t extended, millions could see their insurance premiums more than double 2— forcing impossible choices between medicine, rent, and groceries. This is already happening, Peter. People who buy insurance on their own, outside employer coverage, are starting to receive notices of double-digit increases. For one couple in Eugene, Oregon, they received a notice that their monthly premium would quadruple** — from $443 to over $2,200.3 Democrats must hold the line. Families are counting on them to fight for funding that keeps healthcare affordable. Your stories are what show the human cost — and make it impossible for Congress to ignore. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Peter,
Donald Trump’s reckless and unnecessary government shutdown is hurting working families, veterans, and seniors across Massachusetts. While he spends taxpayer dollars on personal luxuries, millions of people are paying the price.
The Facts in Massachusetts
* 1.1 million residents may lose their SNAP benefits, according to the U.S. Department of Agriculture. If those benefits are cut, it will put enormous pressure on local food banks that are already stretched thin.
* Governor Maura Healey has made clear that the Commonwealth cannot make up the deficit left by Trump’s SNAP freeze.
* 25,000 federal workers in Massachusetts have been furloughed, and Trump has threatened to deny them back pay once the shutdown ends.
* Senate and house staff are working without pay, continuing to provide constituent services even as their own paychecks stop.
* Social Security offices remain open, but staff cuts mean reduced services and longer wait times for Massachusetts residents seeking help.
* Veterans Administration offices are experiencing similar reduction in services, delaying critical benefits for those who served.
* The U.S. The Department of Agriculture has seen widespread disruption, especially in the Farm Service Agency, which provides vital financial assistance to farmers. Farmers in Western Massachusetts have felt the brunt of the shutdown’s impact.
* Health care costs are set to rise dramatically because of Trump’s failure to extend the Affordable Care Act.
* Medicare and Medicaid recipients will continue receiving benefits, but will experience significantly longer wait times for many services.
* Donald Trump has threatened to fire or withhold back pay from furloughed federal workers .
For a comprehensive list of threatened service cuts, visit: Rep. Jim McGovern's Shutdown FAQ [https://mcgovern.house.gov/helping-you/shutdown-faq.htm]
Meanwhile, in Washington...
While millions struggle with lost paychecks and stalled benefits, Donald Trump is destroying the East Wing of the White House to build a $300 million taxpayer-funded ballroom, an act that is likely illegal without Congressional approval.
And in a shocking abuse of power, Trump is demanding $230 million from the Department of Justice to “compensate” himself for being prosecuted, a request that will be decided by his own lawyers.
The Bottom Line
While Massachusetts families face hardship, Trump is focused on enriching himself and rewriting the rules for his own benefit. Democrats are fighting to protect families, restore essential services, and hold him accountable for this reckless shutdown.

body:
This is why our mission is so important.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20251023-1&t=1&akid=2766%2E587540%2EQkutbP)
Peter, it is infuriating to watch the Trump administration wreak havoc on our government and enact their dangerous, destructive agenda.
We need to be taking pages out of Mitch McConnell’s playbook that he used for years to stop Obama, to stop Biden, and prevent Democrats from passing our agenda. Everything has to be on the table to stop and slow Trump.
On top of that, we need to be organizing against vulnerable Republicans and turning the screws on them. We have to make their lives as painful as possible and line up the incentives for them to oppose Trump.
And finally we have to look ahead to upcoming elections and get behind people that are filled with rage over Trump’s actions and have a burning fire within them to stop Trump. People who will fight aggressively for a vision of this country that allows us to have more affordable housing, better healthcare, and provides some real economic opportunity and security.
That’s where we come in.
**[Can you pitch in $5 now to power our mission to elect the next generation of leaders?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251023_1_infuriating.nUqD6o&refcode=em20251023-2766&amount=5&t=3&akid=2766%2E587540%2EQkutbP)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251023_1_infuriating.nUqD6o&amount=5&refcode=em20251023-2766&t=22&akid=2766%2E587540%2EQkutbP)**
This is no joke. _Every single day counts in the fight ahead._
**Here’s the truth:** The GOP is already gearing up for the next fight. If we don’t keep our fundraising on track, the billionaires and corporate elite will keep pouring money into the Republican right-wing agenda while Democrats and progressives are left scrambling.
**But we’re not going to let that happen.** We may not have the special interests on our side, but I know that the grassroots can be even more powerful.
**We need leaders who fight for working families, voting rights, and climate justice. Leaders who will not back down when things get tough.**
That’s exactly why Leaders We Deserve exists. Now, we need your help to make sure we can keep electing the young, progressive leaders we deserve.
**[Can you chip in $5 now to help power our game-changing work?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251023_1_infuriating.nUqD6o&refcode=em20251023-2766&amount=5&t=23&akid=2766%2E587540%2EQkutbP)**
Thank you for being part of this movement,
David Hogg,
Leaders We Deserve
