name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: Charlie always believed this day would come
body:
[unsubscribe](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xul=65a6x69jow166jo1opkmvmi0s14xurwlyqh8bjyotq50iht25hi8kwic3sjqgnlb45t13z8tb4cuksy6cc6kxqc3cx8dz78fq&__stmp=t4lt5g&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *
| | | | [](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=qwikcdl711u8xs3haay7g8cd83dwnr3dhcb61hhrt6i2cavnd8je5gne15dz72eeunguks8evagp5ymxd3te2jtw5phwpka5erfcfm35g959yxy13hf7519s1adqhigzafe&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4lt5g&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---
4940 East Beverly Road
Phoenix, Arizona 85044
---

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Hypocrisy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Trump only cares about billionaires, corporations, and himself.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2684%2E4032634%2Exoi44a)
---
Let's review how Trump and Republicans have been handling American taxpayer funds during his second term: Let’s see...he’s got $20 billion to bail out Argentina. And $45 billion to ICE to ramp up their mass deportation operations. He dedicated $1 billion in taxpayer dollars to refurbish his Qatari jet. And, oh yeah — $170 million to purchase Kristi Noem some private jets, too. Of course, he dedicated over $4 trillion to fund tax cuts for billionaires and wealthy corporations. Meanwhile, Trump has found no room in his budget for anything that might actually help the American people, like: Medicaid. More affordable health insurance. Food assistance. Lifesaving cancer research for children. Special education workers. Clean energy investments. In fact, _Trump would rather shut down the U.S. government_ than spend a dime to prevent people’s health care costs from doubling. He’d rather make federal workers go without pay and have critical services shut down than lift a finger to help people afford health care. But don’t worry — while families struggle with the cost of living, those bulldozers demolishing the East wing of the White House to make space for his ballroom will continue uninterrupted. Budgets show values. Plain and simple. Trump said he would lower costs for Americans on Day 1 — but he has shown that he only values billionaires, corporations, and himself. The lies and the hypocrisy are appalling. But it’s not surprising. Take how Trump recently fired dozens of CDC experts who specialize in detecting disease, right after getting his Covid shot. Or take Trump’s hypocrisy as he vindictively prosecutes his political opponents, including James Comey and Letitia James, while tweeting “JUSTICE MUST BE SERVED, NOW!!!” and claiming his White House has nothing to do with the prosecutions. And remember when Trump was whining to anyone who would listen about free speech, all while turning around and striking what looked like shady backroom deals to silence his critics and cancel comedians? **I’m going to keep calling out Trump’s flagrant hypocrisy. I’ll keep fighting for a government that will actually help working families, not just bankroll Trump’s vanity projects, billionaire tax cuts, and authoritarian regime.** **They want us to feel powerless and hopeless. They want us to feel like there’s nothing we can do to change this. They’re wrong.** [**We can right the wrongs of the Trump Administration. We can still make our government work for working people. I’m not going to give up the fight. If you’re with me, please chip in $28 or anything you can to power our work.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3190?amount=28&t=8&akid=2684%2E4032634%2Exoi44a)

name: Gary Miller for House of Delegates
subject: This isn't just a campaign. It's home.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GARY MILLER FOR DELEGATE** 121 Bell Ct
body:
We are fighting for Dr. Gary Miller because his candidacy isn't just politics to us, it's personal.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us9.campaign-archive.com/?e=606d7e9aa2&u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=93f8a67add)

---](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=9a0fce0544&e=606d7e9aa2)
| | Friend,
My name is Josh, and I'm Dr. Gary Miller's campaign manager. Long before I started working in politics, I was just a kid growing up right here in Southside Virginia. This place, **its struggles, its resilience, and its heart are woven into who I am**.
For years, working on campaigns across the state and country, I held onto a dream: to one day come home and run a race staffed entirely by talented, **dedicated professionals who were** _**from here**_**.** People who didn't just understand the district on paper, but who lived its challenges and celebrated its victories because it was _their_ community, too.
Today, that dream is real. **Our entire team is from Danville, Pittsylvania, or Halifax.** We are the home team. We are fighting for Dr. Gary Miller because his candidacy isn't just another election for us. It's personal.
It's about electing a leader who has spent 36 years healing our neighbors as a doctor. Someone who stepped up to serve on City Council not for ambition, but because **he saw families hurting and knew he had to do more**. Someone who will go to Richmond and fight to keep our local hospital open, because he knows **what happens when care is hours away.** Someone who will fight for our public schools, because like his own mother, sister, and wife, he knows **teachers deserve our respect and support.**
This campaign is about protecting the place we call home and the people we love. It's about ensuring Southside Virginia has a voice in Richmond that truly understands us, that shares our values, and that will **never stop fighting for what is right, no matter who you are or where you call home.**
We are the underdogs in this race. **Our opponent is backed by inherited connections and MAGA extremists trying to buy this seat.** We have something they don't: the heart and soul of this community.
We are running a smart, aggressive campaign built on grassroots energy and professionals who happen to be local. To compete with the outside money flooding into this district from **Dominion Power, Altria** , and others, we need your help right now.
**Will you stand with the home team? Will you invest in a campaign run by, for, and dedicated to the people of Southside Virginia? Your contribution today fuels our fight.**
[**[Chip in $25 to support the hometeam]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=0aacff480b&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Chip in $50 to fight back]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=824f6d0933&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Chip in $100 to help us win]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=7be3519cd1&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Or contribute another amount]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=76adc1262c&e=606d7e9aa2)
Campaigns come and go, but home is forever. Thank you for believing in our team and for helping us bring this one home for Southside and our great Commonwealth.
Solidarity forever,
Josh Norris
Campaign Manager
Gary Miller for House of Delegates

subject: We’re finishing what we started in 2023
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
We’re ready to elect more climate champions in a county long harmed by the fossil fuel industry.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117868436/577905592/1328794144?refcode=ea.c5a4e9be-5ab0-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ms=ea.c5a4e9be-5ab0-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM1YTRlOWJlLTVhYjAtZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8VY2rsN7sc6FoIobb1GSeeXDr-7zUI5rhRG9OPMt8IM=&emci=baa4e9be-5ab0-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=c5a4e9be-5ab0-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=4823105)
---
**If you need something to inspire you today, look no further than Luzerne County, Pennsylvania.** Just two years ago, the Luzerne County Council had a 10–1 Republican supermajority. Most political operatives would’ve written it off as **unwinnable.** But despite the GOP’s grip on a community devastated by abandoned mines, Superfund sites, and unchecked fracking pollution, _there was still hope._ We went all in to endorse local leaders brave enough to challenge Big Oil. And in 2023, we helped flip four seats and broke the Republican stranglehold. Suddenly, the Luzerne County Council went from a 10–1 Republican supermajority to a much less powerful 7–4 GOP majority. **Fast forward to today: We've endorsed three climate champions for the Luzerne County Council, and if we can win just two seats, we can flip the council to a pro-environment majority.** **[JanePAC is proud to stand behind Denise Williams, Dawn Simmons, and Chris Belles for County Council on November 4th. We asked how the shutdown is impacting you — here’s what you said.
#
Recently, we asked how you’re feeling about the Republican shutdown — and the messages we received made one thing clear: **the GOP’s manufactured crisis is causing real harm.**
In a moment, we’re going to share some of the survey responses with you. * _“My single mom daughter is forced to work at her government job without pay. Meanwhile she has a mortgage, car payment, utilities, food, gas, insurance, and other bills to pay. We will need to help her financially because of the shutdown.”

_
* _“My Husband and I work in the airline/transportation industry, and Republicans are causing havoc in the sky. People are actually worried about the safety of our FAA and the literal safety of our planes and air traffic control.”

_
* _“Our son is disabled. We worry about how the shutdown will impact his services. We worry for our friends and family who are going without paychecks.”_

**How are you feeling about the shutdown in general?**
* _“Saddened for the families and employees affected by the shutdown.”

_
* _“Worried and very concerned. Anxious.”

_
* _“PISSED OFF to be honest!”_

**How do you think Democrats should approach the shutdown?**
* _“Democrats need to stand up for our healthcare needs and not allow Republicans to bully them.”

_
* _“The Democrats should continue this fight to restore Affordable Care Act subsidies. Make this the focus. And condemn President Trump for his treatment of government workers and attacking their livelihoods.”

_
* _“As frustrating as this shutdown is, I’m so glad that the Democrats are trying to find their spines and standing up for the American people’s right to healthcare. We cannot keep letting this regime take and take and take. We cannot let them think that this is acceptable to us. Keep fighting. I don’t care how long it takes. Keep fighting for us. Please.”_

**If you shared your story and thoughts with us — thank you.**

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

Patriot, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
| [ ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=46561b12e0c3430389e4659cf3d234f9&_e=C1Ck0G8sqa7u_7o_B4kCUFPSHxpCFfEvBhd-lZQLvP97uU8ONNoKcdK6fNrv0PhV3V7cVpInAYj_o4-TN8bU6lJGpHXKse3axtEMs97eztGYu_HGyRkSIBtm2dL2P39Be5NF2iMF0a-hoDS1Bhp5cfW2Bc6oZ0IZ4AJ_fY5rizaiSh24xukWLh8EiBLCq5xYAojCJ8PYuJGtPyfwDd5VRtuEfmatD_Sa97j7AS-nxSSRnAWbYCzZU8arbVsxuCXJ4vHKoFdwN1JT7WfLRq3YlkdFsmJtBz7I4ycddSiquqP-wWZ5-T6Tgq23H0GCBx8LJDu1HI1TQZ8pLLWopSxZ9p-FSoLGbLbv3Y11jUbHqRU7ZCm-cONBeRhQepIG3_d2G9E9hc6-w17JSVzKGqhPcGlmr1tTV7rRGaUc5t2fSo6WxLlzhhEhw3nD9fRmXRxndvrajXhxIWj7dZT4jRzfM0jRFUWtzUK6seFJDcsCEQfQIDwcnzU9wOodPU0A7mAacfUsrXNgnDgUiBsgFRgipTI0jTUJ_fmGtXwz1Vq6jjWewtZMzItnQk8nVQoKoojW3SZqQuQlbz7EFw9P5UZrAZT3zfwKh6lz9h4QFQb613BKGEX9vWPMCd2tP40vGh8wySEveTGG538hwxtdmOk5Gu8YZKIEoqi1V1eU_blPPh9gGLX1o38ElkzGJFY1t7Q9rlDIxROfotuR6ZEHA1fqlg%3D%3D)

_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
| [ ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=46561b12e0c3430389e4659cf3d234f9&_e=C1Ck0G8sqa7u_7o_B4kCUFPSHxpCFfEvBhd-lZQLvP97uU8ONNoKcdK6fNrv0PhV3V7cVpInAYj_o4-TN8bU6lJGpHXKse3axtEMs97eztGYu_HGyRkSIBtm2dL2P39Be5NF2iMF0a-hoDS1Bhp5cfW2Bc6oZ0IZ4AJ_fY5rizaiSh24xukWLh8EiBLCq5xYAojCJ8PYuJGtPyfwDd5VRtuEfmatD_Sa97j7AS-nxSSRnAWbYCzZU8arbVsxuCXJWep6hPHFe8ZGw3v22zNK5Ie687KeoiLooouSQVLyVQnTSHhYOPapDMDiBnucYYVLy1M-rMMCfxCLYWVzXvx8lvfDpHE3yFZdZ3mJxsGVV8igCJARX12CHRkWsaClJ-Q8StDe1U6NzUuJjC6ransvtttKqhR3jt5LTU19mq4XKBW4mrWJRrTQ6H0fNj_RmOcMImYN49b7r5ilawNCGktZDmy-YMOk_yW5PchNAX-6KBPbBrRwBoF5EsJMFEEQCKfd53Zg2M791OaDjz0IHoLEQUI-ZaGr0AE09ZxFIDjM_E9kuBwqa_xmaiyhIKiwKlnvRmX6ZK8Rb3SoIn_q_BBVPQu6eaNr5adWqTC6owMi7O1AYP1-vR5PNDocb-rFHUJeJbxwkphXnu34Q_rAbvQPruGu7m-HMGSXL1RP0heRpLujeHUrBfUSELiyGiDD10ivGB6LCpD0KFMwCtrvZCjZ5Q%3D%3D)

We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _

_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Patriot, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**

Trump back in the White House in 2024. We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- and it delivered real results. 10 for 10. In every single state we operated in... Trump won. In Arizona alone, we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. In Wisconsin? 60,000+. In Nevada? 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. In Michigan? 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... We made history. | Above: Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. Because Charlie never stopped. He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- and make it stronger than ever. Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- we must turn it into action. He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: " What are we building next?" Well, Patriot, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time. | But it doesn 't happen without you. So, here 's my ask... Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work. For Charlie. God Bless, Tyler Bowyer Chief Operating Officer Turning Point Action P.S. I would give anything to have Charlie back. But he left us with something powerful -- a machine that works... a machine that's proven and battle-tested. Now it's time to run it -- and run it like never before. Bigger. Bolder. More battlegrounds. More victories. Because right now, thanks to a generous supporter of Turning Point Action, your gift will be matched dollar-for-dollar -- up to $500,000, through October 31. That means, with your gift today: ✅ 2X the activists trained ✅ 2X the voters registered ✅ 2X the pressure on weak-kneed politicians ✅ 2X the ballot-chasing operations ✅ 2X the grassroots strength the Left can't stop We don't need to reinvent anything. Charlie already drew the blueprint and turned the key. So, if you've been wondering how to help... If you've been asking " what now?" Then, Patriot, this is your moment to step in, fuel the fight, and take Charlie 's vision to the next level. Let's turn this energy -- this momentum -- into action. You know those shows where you finish recording and just sit there thinking, "Holy hell, what did we just uncover?" Yeah--this was one of those.

He's been seething over Trump's grotesque demolition of the White House East Wing--literally bulldozing a piece of American history to build a Versailles-style ballroom so he can throw himself parties while the country starves.
It hit him hard, personally; that East Wing was where he first walked into the People's House as a young reporter. That sense of national violation--of something sacred being trashed for ego--set the tone.

Peter,

Earlier this month, my team reached out about next month’s important election in California. Proposition 50 is the ballot measure that could decide how California’s congressional maps are drawn, and whether national Republicans succeed in their plan to rig the House majority for years to come.

**Just this week, North Carolina advanced new maps to give Republicans an additional seat in the House while cutting out Democratic representation.** This comes after Texas and other GOP-controlled states did the same.

Unlike these legislatures, California is putting new maps to a vote by the people. If Prop 50 is passed, it would level the playing field ahead of next year’s critical midterm elections and keep our democracy intact.

body:
Democrats can’t flip the Senate without winning New Hampshire. That’s why we have to rally around Chris right now.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=3062%2E582294%2EE_dqv-)
We have a problem.
A top election analyst just downgraded our chances of winning the U.S. Senate race in New Hampshire after former Sen. John Sununu announced his comeback bid.
Let us be absolutely clear: **If Chris Pappas loses in New Hampshire, Democrats have _no_ viable path to flipping the Senate.**
We can’t afford to fall behind in this moment. **[That’s why we’re asking you to support Chris with a donation today.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251023_3_ratings.zOJFc3&refcode=em20251023-3&t=2&akid=3062%2E582294%2EE_dqv-)**
With Senator Shaheen retiring, this seat is wide open and extremely vulnerable.
And with Sununu in the race, Republicans just got a huge boost in their efforts to flip this seat and keep the Senate majority.
John Sununu isn’t just any Republican. He’s backed by the entire Washington establishment. He comes from a political dynasty, has national name recognition, and brings a fundraising machine fueled by Wall Street and corporate special interests.
**Chris Pappas is the Democrat who can win this race.** He’s a proven public servant who’s won his purple Congressional district in New Hampshire four times. But this race just got more expensive, more competitive, and more dangerous for Democrats. That’s why we’re asking:
**[Can you chip in right now to help Chris Pappas win New Hampshire’s Senate race and stop Republicans’ scheme to keep control of the Senate?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251023_3_ratings.zOJFc3&refcode=em20251023-3&t=3&akid=3062%2E582294%2EE_dqv-)**
**[RUSH A DONATION »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251023_3_ratings.zOJFc3&refcode=em20251023-3&t=4&akid=3062%2E582294%2EE_dqv-)**
Far-right billionaires and special interests are already flooding New Hampshire with cash to flip this seat red.
If Democrats lose here, we lose the Senate. It’s that simple. We must hold this seat by electing Chris Pappas to keep our chances of flipping Senate control alive. And that only happens if we help him build the grassroots support he’ll need to overcome the money pouring into New Hampshire.
**[Please make a donation right now. It’s never been more critical.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251023_3_ratings.zOJFc3&refcode=em20251023-3&t=5&akid=3062%2E582294%2EE_dqv-)**

Thanks for stepping up,
Team Pappas

Patriot, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
| [ ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=336a529c848b498eb08a4cefd60e577d&_e=C80qAcySdLofLrWP8MVBwEkzFq71RBn9fZzYF2wzKdEQAJgxcBNsLVL0dI1YdprNa4J3ypBnsliTSuxYoBl-1oxspli0_cAen0wDKLZGwlNOO07wYNKMnPqSQA1OR3zS0KflvOcpPvMB5gz_kBo8hJFbjBGPWCnjmNHLCMf4AYTEOEurlv4WyMa4454cNK9Ek1U7KJsEHEO66OjlBI4H7ryGmANGkQFqLvcRqc5LSMKtxmezDrDnAvNC4fX2MRrCaoS2oZKMLh2JkSGElqSfiSEQl5qFzk_TahkW9J_VYKGXBR8_wv4Z3PsCWn1kW5oKuDwbN0lG2BJkoRT55Spvqq7cwXCWBnTUd6urj9e5UtIkMEw_KfUl6Gn6qBLc6c4gxOnRbSrOMxyxaESja20D0NVw4XIGtJQ9opRIzAPyvJ2iUO5cQmRwgPO2aA0WrHdcCMvcd63aDdn67A_7CzNxHYvID8tnxYuCL0ogmXCGfNe98RiX_-5GBKawiGLu_lIJvcAQVENHpi-RzX1czJnZHS7EhZf6Xq2ggtibqVMPyhZxptUsSnZ6cc78OHlsG5HewjiGy04eh9VbtQHfocXZghdOuzJarxOxmOw005dOFnRNT3Ar6jNEiGshreyMp0c5MuCy-Bp148ccTl4VHaeXqYs08arQTOqhaM1hGLiaZcwh4urve_8fkg_EmdxBw1Cx2nC0N1OE1tw_bLeRonrNjQ%3D%3D)
---
_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
| [ ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=336a529c848b498eb08a4cefd60e577d&_e=C80qAcySdLofLrWP8MVBwEkzFq71RBn9fZzYF2wzKdEQAJgxcBNsLVL0dI1YdprNa4J3ypBnsliTSuxYoBl-1oxspli0_cAen0wDKLZGwlNOO07wYNKMnPqSQA1OR3zS0KflvOcpPvMB5gz_kBo8hJFbjBGPWCnjmNHLCMf4AYTEOEurlv4WyMa4454cNK9Ek1U7KJsEHEO66OjlBI4H7ryGmANGkQFqLvcRqc5LSMKtxmezDrDnAvNC4fX2MRrCP83lSXY6_MYTxr1eboEWnwwW2QuN_vx1oVtg8ksjIqYN_njhTwnaM_9WCLwDW4gWCD9u2L5wzFrDhjoK0EuAVZjWIgsqE7enh0gLYD9fVXZ1zaH4IHS4aR1of0lqpobrSTCaz_4GYpd5mCenst4ikkmBgua-siFMKl-4ZpHboqSFzuHwq46vl22_kFf2uFicNWNY2Os2EtkFsuVnepwvFu150Dkx39dzCq2m2p77eXlZek7TRdVNzacFg310uhz7shDEOAXLPtW26Z1t8PAcc6cE7dMx2JtZIhHV6I7oUUUVgVca8A2wFCva0JNEaSBG_GqtxLuGK73qrIyu_6rTQITrkhTxsX8OrGJzmuQtH89JE-3P8dfpyvltW8Vp1BHGhVnO_9jc_k3S-PCJome777shitU49awoRXRh4XlqNm81lpjtey0hdTP1pyzRVTohESPHscUO_KDnovUVUD4pPA%3D%3D)

We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _
| [ ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=336a529c848b498eb08a4cefd60e577d&_e=C80qAcySdLofLrWP8MVBwEkzFq71RBn9fZzYF2wzKdEQAJgxcBNsLVL0dI1YdprNa4J3ypBnsliTSuxYoBl-1oxspli0_cAen0wDKLZGwlNOO07wYNKMnPqSQA1OR3zS0KflvOcpPvMB5gz_kBo8hJFbjBGPWCnjmNHLCMf4AYTEOEurlv4WyMa4454cNK9Ek1U7KJsEHEO66OjlBI4H7ryGmANGkQFqLvcRqc5LSMKtxmezDrDnAvNC4fX2MRrCenlXWAdjnMgKahKaHo17GPSyRMLmsN0qh06l5D29nukPZKAg8GTaiMrgo_p0lXWmXiM_p9wAXrluSYMCfKEsjCPZCj_glXR1TZ9ME_xs2OjdJAKhy5uf7R34_UfevgsLmdo_nZD0jxXOYJiz9peGk4MAxwTDCljTGXGtYxgJWvVhukat3x_iqwdMzR48iexPeyt8Mbp3W-SAhzVNeAxKL1KI2n6FOX5PgpaSB_KA8tgGOK1UKFYHqq9t0cxZVMK1IlNkwnSvsP-fux6wPmpftqVPMjYcs2ASLjN_JuHx_tXUMm8ZmBZSAxfHTmjpM0Y07me3wVM9qw84YK4MCUtoTEf1SowbZcx-LpDZEcPp8mv3h34ZHhwkrJlsKGesXefg9uAAoJ060s3vdCuCWEpUaQePpTUm-fq_SU3AGQ85zZm6ztXtEt3-S04y16DBEL1hgL9f1XUfxaJPMJiM_DxxtQ%3D%3D)

_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... subject: This fight is not over
body:
| | Peter – This is what a post-_Roe_ America looks like: Clinics and hospitals in rural communities like ours have been shuttered, leaving so many women and mothers without access to care. Maternal mortality rates continue to rise.

Yet, ultra-conservatives in the House cut Medicaid and defunded Planned Parenthood, directly endangering the health and lives of millions. **Now, more than ever, we can’t afford to lose pro-choice leaders like Marie.** [Pitch in right away to defend her against anti-abortion extremists who want to flip this seat. →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117870798/577913390/140983856?amount=10&refcode=MGP_EM_FR_90DO_251023_2_2&refcode2=044194e8-61b0-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDQxOTRlOC02MWIwLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lMxaFcjTdmoYTmLnBiawvVH8_ZyptzRoRTH4oL2CiA4=)

– MGP for Congress

_Begin Forwarded Message:_

Peter – It’s no secret that reproductive care and abortion access are under grave threat from ultra-conservative extremists across the country.

Now, a few months after Planned Parenthood lost federal Medicaid funding thanks to the GOP’s July budget bill, many clinics have been shuttered, and the remaining ones are struggling to survive.

Washington State has stepped up to cover the funding gap and fight back in the courts, but we can’t stop there. If these federal attacks continue, millions of women nationwide stand to lose access to affordable preventive care, cancer screenings, contraception, and other critical health services.

Lives are at risk, Peter. That’s no exaggeration. _Especially_ in rural communities like ours, where the nearest women’s health clinic may be hours away.

| | Team, In the past few months, we’ve seen _individual_ states like Texas gerrymander their congressional maps for the 2026 elections. **But the Supreme Court might be about to set off a new,_region-wide_ mad dash of redistricting, with the entire South drawing new maps by the beginning of next year, and with states like Texas empowered to enact even more extreme gerrymanders.** Here’s how: The Court appears ready to strike down protections in the Voting Rights Act Act against racially discriminatory maps. # **2 Million Pennsylvanians Will Lose Their SNAP Benefits if Republicans Don 't Act**
_SNAP recipients will not receive benefits in November unless Republicans end the government shutdown_ It was announced this week that the Republican government shutdown will now impact SNAP recipients. The [Department of Human Services](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170887.172276.107&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15911) has sounded the alarm that [Pennsylvania will not receive payments for November](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170887.172276.107&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15912) because of the ongoing Republican government shutdown. Back when Republicans passed the Big Ugly Bill over the summer, Senator Hughes and Governor Shapiro made clear that Pennsylvania did not have the money to cover healthcare and food support cuts that Republicans supported. Now we're seeing in real time what happens when the federal government doesn't provide the funding for crucial programs like SNAP. **Over 700,000 Pennsylvania children rely on SNAP for their day to day meals** **** **Where to Access Food** If you, a loved one, or neighbor need help accessing food while SNAP benefits are unavailable, the following organizations and programs can help.
* Call 211 or visit [PA211.org](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170887.172276.107&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15913) to find local food banks and other food assistance programs
* [Feeding Pennsylvania](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170887.172276.107&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15914)
* [Share Food Program](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170887.172276.107&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15915)
* [Philabundance](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170887.172276.107&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15916)
* [City of Philadelphia Food and Meal Finder ](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170887.172276.107&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15917)
* [Montgomery County Food Resources ](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170887.172276.107&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15918)

Peter, you may have seen my campaign motto by now: _**Tested. Trusted. Tough.**_ It's not just a slogan, and I'd like to explain it to you.
---
|
---
**TESTED.** I don't back down from challenges. During my time in the legislature, I helped pass difficult budgets, and when it came down to saving the PFD, I went against party bosses and voted with the PEOPLE of Alaska. After winning five elections during my career in public service, I know how to win, make friends, and my experience uniquely qualifies me to be a strong steward of our state. **TRUSTED.** During my time in Juneau and at the Department of Corrections, I earned the trust of my constituents, fellow Republicans, co-workers, and even Democrats! It's because of my dedication to our state and helping people that I've also earned the title **"Uncorruptible"**. It takes time to gain trust, and I continue to live and work with respect for everyone I meet, even if we disagree. **TOUGH.** Listen, you'll never get anything done in Juneau unless you have that true Alaskan grit. _**Don't mistake my kindness for weakness. **_ I'm a compassionate conservative, but when it's time to suit up and fight for what's right, I'm the woman in the arena.
---
|
---

I'm in it to get to work, as I always have been. Nancy Dahlstrom Alaska's Lieutenant Governor & Your 2026 Republican Candidate for Governor | | | | | ---|---|---

body:

A New Mexico judge just told the Supreme Court to kick rocks. If you think the homeless crisis can't get worse, [watch what happens](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=bddebb9d10&e=567664f14c) when judges decide people have a constitutional right to camp on every sidewalk in town.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=f3346a177e&e=567664f14c)
| |

## ⚖️ Judge vs. Supreme Court: The Homeless Showdown

Judge Joshua Allison just decided the U.S. Supreme Court got it wrong on homelessness. SCOTUS ruled cities CAN clear encampments. But Allison says New Mexico's constitution might give people the right to camp on sidewalks anyway.
The city, Sam Bregman, and Rio Rancho all warned this will make clearing encampments impossible. The New Mexico Supreme Court refused to stop him. This case won't be heard until 2026, so expect more chaos until then—like the encampment that blocked First and I-40 during a kids' volleyball game last week.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=9418915c99&e=567664f14c)
---
| |

**🚨 FACT-CHECK BACKFIRE: Channel 7 Exposes Keller**
Tim Keller told Alex Uballez he was lying during the debate and challenged Channel 7 to fact-check it. So they did. Turns out Uballez was telling the truth—a senior director WAS fired for giving him a tour of the West Side homeless shelter.
The termination letter said it was for providing "an unauthorized tour" that could "jeopardize funding." A mayoral candidate can't tour a publicly-funded facility without someone losing their job. Think about that.

## 💰 Heinrich Chooses Politics Over Paychecks

Day 23 of the government shutdown. Over 22,000 federal workers in New Mexico aren't getting paid. And Martin Heinrich keeps voting to keep it closed.
Republicans offered a clean bill to fund government at Biden-level spending for seven weeks. Democrats have blocked it eleven times. Heinrich told CNN he won't "pit government employees against each other"—but he's the one refusing to let ANY of them get paid. Even John Fetterman called it "embarrassing" and keeps voting to reopen. When a Democrat in a hoodie has more sense than your senator, something's wrong.

name: AOC
subject: We are here to transform the politics of this country.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
We are here to transform the politics of this country.
And the only way that we will do that is by winning with mandates.
What we have to demonstrate — not just to Republicans, but even within our own party — is that _we are ready_ to guarantee health care to every single American.
_We are ready_ for a politics that unapologetically supports the labor movement and the right to a union.
_We are ready_ for politics that supports rights to clean air and clean water; that understands welcoming immigrants is part of supporting our success as a nation; that we have to dismantle an unjust criminal justice system, and in order to actually establish public safety, we must open paths to education.
And we do that by making sure that we aren't just aiming for mere victory.
We are aiming to prove that our communities cannot be bought by special interests. **We have to show them that their money is no good here**.
Our representation should not go to the highest bidder.
I can’t do this work without you — the grassroots supporters who have had my back every step of the way. I don't curry favor with billionaires or host exclusive fundraising events. This campaign's average donation floats around $17-20.
[Will you make a $5 contribution today to our fight? Every dollar powers our grassroots organizing in red, blue, and purple districts across the country to build a people’s movement for progressive change. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20251023.l61RNy&refcode=em20251023-10045-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10045%2E2526796%2EcQE9ov)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

subject: I want you to meet Juli

body:
[1]Powered By People

I recently got back home from the No Kings Rally in Austin, and I have to
tell you about someone who reminded me of exactly why we’re in this fight.
Her name is Juli, and she’s an incredible volunteer with Powered by
People.

Juli was at the rally from the very first moment to the very last. She was
registering voters, educating folks, answering questions, and having so
many conversations that she ran out of voter registration forms by the end
of the day. And she didn’t slow down for a second — not even in the Texas
heat.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20251023.EhONdf&refcode=ema20251023-240420&t=1002&akid=240420%2E444211%2Ey87ia6 ]Volunteer Juli at No Kings rally

That’s the kind of on-the-ground dedication Powered by People volunteers
bring to communities across Texas and beyond. Powered by People isn’t just
about showing up — it’s about organizing neighbors, empowering voters, and
building the kind of people-powered movement that wins elections up and
down the ballot. Every conversation, every voter registration form, every
volunteer hour adds up to real change.

What Juli did all day long at No Kings isn’t just impressive — it’s
impactful. Each voter she talked to is another voice in our democracy.
Each person she registered is a step closer to ensuring we win in 2026.
And that’s what Powered by People looks like: relentless, fearless, and
unstoppable.

But we can’t do this work alone. We need volunteers, organizers, and
people like Juli and you to keep this movement going strong. Your support
fuels our organizing work on the ground — from training volunteers to
getting forms in people’s hands — so that come 2026, we’re ready to fight
and win for the people.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20251023.EhONdf&refcode=ema20251023-240420&t=1003&akid=240420%2E444211%2Ey87ia6 ]Will you chip in $3 to Powered by People today? Your
contribution powers volunteers like Juli and helps grow our movement. By
relying on people power, we don’t just hope for change — we make it
happen.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20251023.EhONdf&refcode=ema20251023-240420&amounts=3&t=1022&akid=240420%2E444211%2Ey87ia6 ]DONATE $3

Beto O’Rourke
